Title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager - Web & Cloud Platforms
Industry: Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, Book and Periodical Publishing, and Telecommunications
Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
As Senior Technical Delivery Manager, you will build and lead high-performance engineering teams that deliver and run our Web, Services, Middleware and Cloud Native platforms. You will own the full lifecycle, from strategy and architecture through delivery and day-to-day operations, using modern technologies such as React, Angular, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot and .NET, deployed on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud with Kubernetes and serverless services.
  
  
This is a leadership role with two equal mandates drive innovation at the core of how we build, and achieve operational excellence in how we run. You will set engineering direction, grow managers and senior engineers, and deliver industry-standard, secure and scalable solutions that let our customers self-serve. You will partner with senior leadership to align technology investment with business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build, lead and grow high-performance delivery teams, including managers and technical leads.
* Own the strategy and roadmap for Web, Services, Middleware and Cloud Native platforms.
* Drive innovation by evaluating emerging technologies and scaling proven ideas into production. Deliver large programs end to end, on time, on budget and against clear KPIs.
* Oversee architecture, integration and code quality to industry standards, including APIs, microservices and GraphQL.
* Lead cloud-native build and migration, with strong DevOps, automation and cost control.
* Embed secure authentication and SSO across applications, working with security and identity teams.
* Own operational excellence availability, SLOs, incident management, monitoring and root cause analysis.
* Partner with Product, Design, Data, Security and Operations, and present strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Cloud experience (required) hands-on depth with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), including PaaS, containers and Kubernetes, serverless and cloud-native architecture patterns.
* Proven record of building and leading high-performance engineering teams, including managing managers, in an enterprise environment.
* Strong expertise across web application frameworks (React, Angular or Vue on the frontend; Node.js, Java/Spring Boot on the backend), backend services and APIs, microservices and middleware.
* Solid knowledge of integration and middleware technologies API gateways, messaging and event streaming, ESB and iPaaS.
* Deep understanding of industry standards for connecting domain services, microservices and experience-layer services such as GraphQL and REST.
* Mature DevOps and SRE practice CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, SLOs and incident management.
* Strong leadership in Agile delivery at scale, with a track record of shipping quickly without compromising quality or stability.
* Data-driven, KPI-focused approach, using tools such as 5-why analysis, A/B testing and performance benchmarking.
* Ability to balance innovation with operational stability, cost and risk.
* Excellent communication, with the ability to influence senior leaders and translate complex engineering topics into business value.
* Curiosity, creativity and a bias for action when tackling complex problems.

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of authentication and identity platforms, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, ForgeRock or Auth0.
* Experience implementing SSO and identity federation using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SAML.
* Familiarity with customer identity (CIAM), MFA and zero-trust security models.
* Relevant certifications, such as a cloud architect certification, Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD) or SAFe.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering and technical delivery, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years managing managers or multiple squads.
* Proven delivery of web, services, middleware and cloud-native solutions at enterprise scale.
* A track record of running production platforms with measurable gains in reliability, performance and cost.
* A passion for digital transformation and a demonstrated ability to deliver innovative solutions that improve customer experience.

**What’s in it for you?**
We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including
  
  

* Competitive salary & annual bonus.

* Discounts Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.

* Growth & Development Opportunities

Title: Data Center Program Manager
Description:
**Overview**

As a Microsoft **Data Center Project Manager** (DCPM), you will perform troubleshooting for service incidents, manage assigned projects to meet service delivery objectives as well escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles. You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide mentorship across data centers by sharing best practices.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCPM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Demonstrate conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
* Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.

* Perform troubleshooting for service incidents and escalates, as appropriate, to meet SLA/OLAs, with minimal disruption to the client/customer and business.
* Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.
* Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.
* Manage relationships with clients and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.
* Suggest ways for reducing the risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
* In alignment with management priorities, hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). Support escalation of issues to appropriate owner.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 2+ years experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments
  + OR equivalent experience

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling).
* Technical College degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
* Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, PMP, ITIL, CDCP.

Title: Senior Telemetry Service Operations Manager
Description:
**Overview**
As a Microsoft
**Senior Telemetry Service Operations Manager**
, you will own the availability, quality, and trustworthiness of critical environment (CE) telemetry across Microsoft’s global data center fleet. You will set operational standards and drive external providers and internal engineering teams to resolve complex issues, improve service performance, and reduce systemic risk.
  
  
Telemetry Service Operations (TSO) monitors telemetry availability and quality across Microsoft’s data center portfolio. The team takes a proactive approach by identifying availability, quality, and operational issues before they affect the teams that depend on the data. We validate issues before escalation, so partners receive actionable information.
  
  
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As part of CO+I, you will play a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft’s online services, including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. CO+I supports the personal and professional development of employees through training, growth opportunities, career rotation programs, inclusion programs, and professional certifications.
  
  
Our infrastructure comprises a global portfolio of more than 300 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. It is built and managed by subject matter experts who support services used by more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve to meet changing business demands.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to achieve our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own telemetry health for a region or external-provider portfolio; independently detect and validate complex incidents; determine severity, scope, and business impact in ambiguous situations; and identify fleet-level or systemic risks.
* Own complex and long-running incidents through their full lifecycle, set the standard for investigation and record quality, manage provider escalation paths, and drive accountability for remediation and service-level performance.
* Lead post-incident review and problem management for major, recurring, or high-impact issues; confirm root causes, assess wider fleet exposure, and drive corrective actions to closure across organizational boundaries.
* Set direction for closing telemetry-coverage and detection gaps, translate operational risk into prioritized engineering requirements, and lead automation and alert-tuning initiatives that improve detection coverage and reduce manual effort.
* Own service-acceptance standards, operating procedures, playbooks, and knowledge content for an assigned area, and resolve cross-team issues when telemetry does not meet readiness criteria.
* Define service measures and reporting, represent telemetry performance and external-provider accountability in operational reviews, and communicate risks and remediation status to leadership and partner organizations.
* Lead cross-team service-quality initiatives and mentor service managers and vendor staff, acting as an escalation point for difficult incidents, investigations, and external-provider engagements.
* Participate in a shared on-call rotation supporting 24x7x365 telemetry operations, including scheduled coverage outside standard business hours, weekends, and holidays, and serve as the senior escalation point for major incidents during those periods.
* Set a continuous feedback loop with downstream customers and act as the coordinator between users of the data and telemetry technical implementation groups.
* Embody our culture and values.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field AND 4+ years of technical experience in service operations, service engineering, systems engineering, critical environment operations, industrial control systems, or incident management

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**
While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Domain background in data center critical environments, electrical, industrial, or mechanical systems, gained through formal study or hands-on field experience.
* 5+ years of experience in an operational, mission-critical, 24x7x365 environment.
* 3+ years of experience leading incident, problem, or service-management work, including formal root-cause analysis, post-incident review, and corrective-action ownership; ITIL or equivalent service-management experience.
* Deep working knowledge of data center critical environment equipment, industrial control systems, and telemetry data flows, including generators, uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, switchgear, Modbus, or BACnet.
* Experience analyzing large operational datasets and defining service measures or dashboards using tools such as Kusto, SQL, Power BI, or Grafana.
* Experience holding third-party providers accountable through escalations and performance reviews and driving corrective action across teams without direct authority.
* Experience defining operational standards, playbooks, or service processes and mentoring less-experienced engineers or service managers.
* Deep working knowledge of data center critical environment equipment, industrial control systems, and telemetry data flows, including generators, uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, switchgear, Modbus, or BACnet.
* Experience using Kusto Query Language (KQL) or similar tools to query and analyze large-scale telemetry or operational data.

Description:

---------------

The Network Design and Deployment Team (NIDD) team oversees the design and deployment of cable infrastructure within ADC regions. This includes milestone review, comment issuance, and ensuring accuracy and efficiency. NIDD planning also assesses partner team designs to ensure compliance with AWS and customer requirements, focusing on cabling pathways, sizing, location, type, classification, and installation. The team provides telecom room designs, including sizing and power for various rooms, as well as user-outlet designs. The role involves coordinating meetings with partner teams to clarify ownership for delivering connectivity, working with multiple design/construction teams from pre-permit to hand-off to operations.  
  
The AWS Network Design and Deployment Team (NIDD) team is searching for a passionate and talented Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to drive Data Center and Network Capacity planning in N. America. You will assess the demand requirements along with available network resources to determine and drive prime solutions for our customers. You will work with stakeholders to complete pre-requisites necessary to deliver critical networking capacity. You will lead programs with goals to improve infrastructure resource utilization and availability. You will work with teams across the ADC Organization to effectively plan and deliver data center capacity.  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. This position requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Monitor the network health, customer demand, anticipate risks, resolve issues and initiate corrective action as appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders (networking engineers/tech program managers/senior management) to define requirements and processes.
* Manage the dependencies and the interfaces between projects and negotiate the trade-offs needed.
* Provide program progress reporting on a regular basis.
* End to end responsibility for the program’s execution and success.
* Manage multiple competing projects/programs simultaneously.
* Develop and implement scalable, data-driven process improvement/automated solutions.
* Keep the customer experience as the primary focus.

Chaque projet d'envergure au sein du Réseau d’IA tissé de Bell soulève des centaines de questions :
  
  
L'alimentation électrique est-elle suffisante? La connectivité peut-elle être livrée? Quels sont les enjeux réglementaires, environnementaux, commerciaux, communautaires, opérationnels ou techniques? AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Services is looking for an Infrastructure Technical Program Manager to support and deploy one of the world’s largest and most complex telecommunication networks. The role is responsible for the execution of a strategic plan to improve the business processes and deployment of hyper-scaled cloud infrastructure, creation of a quality control system for North and South America (NASA), pre/post-inspections for design validation, and piloting stakeholder communication for delivery schedules. This opportunity is within the Global Connectivity Infrastructure Delivery - Fiber Deployment organization, which is responsible for project management, quality and delivery of fiber capacity for the physical network solutions that drive Amazon’s internal infrastructure and connect our services to the world.

Title: Network Development Manager, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Networking
Description:
**Description**
Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026
  
  
Amazon's network is a key differentiator for AWS, enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) extends that platform to the U.S. Government's most sensitive workloads, delivering AWS inside air-gapped, classified regions where the bar for reliability, security, and operational rigor is at its highest.
  
  
We are looking for a Network Development Manager to hire, manage, and develop a team of Network Development Engineers responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network. You will own capacity management and forecast planning, implementation, automation, change control, process management, and continuous improvement across the classified partitions. You will represent networking to service teams, infrastructure partners, and government stakeholders, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery, and safe operations in an environment where the margin for error is small and much of the tooling and telemetry commercial teams rely on has to be built.
  
  
At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be strong engineers who dive deep and help their engineers make sound decisions and deliver quality solutions. You will maintain a solid technical understanding of routing, switching, optical transport, and network automation, and ensure the right expertise exists on the team. You will also be a thoughtful people manager who mentors your engineers and builds an environment of mutual trust and respect, which matters even more in ADC where teams are smaller, more isolated, and carry a heavier operational load per person. The ideal candidate has a track record of driving operations and continuous improvement for large-scale, mission-critical networks, a passion for operational excellence, and the judgment to safely implement change, measure performance, and respond to events so the network always operates as intended.
  
  
The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network across the classified partitions: availability, performance, change control, and continuous improvement.
* Hire, develop, and retain a team of Network Development Engineers; own onboarding, career growth, 1:1s, and mentoring.
* Run a sustainable on-call rotation that honors SLAs without burning out a small classified-region team.
* Ensure network changes are designed, reviewed, and executed safely at scale under ADC's access and change-control constraints.
* Drive incidents and availability risks to resolution, and own Correction of Error (COE) follow-through so problems do not recur.
* Manage operations with data, metrics, and dashboards; build the monitoring, automation, and tooling ADC has historically lacked.
* Define and deliver team goals, align resources, and report status and risk to leadership.
* Close parity gaps with commercial AWS and contribute an ADC lens to standard planning (OP1/OP2).
* Represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government stakeholders so dependencies and deliverables are met.

A day in the life
  
  
You lead a team of Network Development Engineers operating AWS's network inside classified regions. A typical day mixes 1:1s and career coaching with reviewing network changes, walking through an incident or COE with an engineer, and unblocking cross-team dependencies. You spend time on the metrics that show where the network and the team need attention, and on the tooling, automation, and monitoring ADC is still building. You balance day-to-day operations against longer-term parity and capacity goals, and you represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government partners. You also participate in a management on-call escalation rotation.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 4+ years of managing teams experience
* 5+ years of engineering experience
* 8+ years of technology role experience
* Experience with network operations either as a manager or individual contributor

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience contributing to the creation and implementation of high-quality, high-volume recruiting plans
* Experience contributing to the definition and implementation of automation opportunities within an operations environment
* Experience representing your team or technical area to senior management

Title: Technical Program Manager - Multi-Hybrid Cloud Operations
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting and Telecommunications
Description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Technical Program Manager – Multi-Hybrid Cloud Operations**
to lead the planning, transformation, governance, and delivery of complex cloud and infrastructure programs.

The successful candidate will oversee the transition and integration of public, private, sovereign, and on-premises cloud environments, ensuring seamless operations, security, reliability, cost efficiency, and service continuity.

This role requires strong technical knowledge, program leadership, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, technology vendors, and senior stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end multi-hybrid cloud transformation programs, from planning and architecture through implementation, migration, and operational handover.
* Develop and manage program roadmaps, budgets, timelines, resources, milestones, risks, and delivery plans.
* Coordinate cloud engineering, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application, and operations teams.
* Oversee cloud platforms and environments, including
  **Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), sovereign/private clouds, and on-premises infrastructure**
  .
* Govern cloud architecture, landing zones, tenant integration, connectivity, identity management, and infrastructure services.
* Ensure effective implementation of cloud operations, automation, monitoring, logging, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
* Oversee platform operations, incident management, problem management, change management, service delivery, and technical support (L1–L3).
* Drive service reliability, availability, disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data protection, data residency, regulatory, and enterprise architecture requirements.
* Lead cloud financial management (FinOps), including cost monitoring, forecasting, resource optimization, and capacity planning.
* Manage cloud service providers, managed service providers, system integrators, and technology vendors.
* Establish service-level agreements (SLAs), operational-level agreements (OLAs), service-level objectives (SLOs), governance frameworks, and operational readiness standards.
* Provide executive-level reporting on program progress, risks, financial performance, service delivery, and operational readiness.
* Lead and mentor project managers, technical leads, and cross-functional delivery teams.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.
* Extensive experience managing complex cloud, infrastructure, platform, or digital transformation programs.
* Strong experience in multi-cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, private cloud, and sovereign cloud environments.
* Hands-on technical understanding of:
* **Cloud Platforms:**
  Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* **Cloud Architecture:**
  Cloud landing zones, tenant architecture, hybrid connectivity, cloud migration, and infrastructure services.
* **Infrastructure and Networking:**
  On-premises infrastructure, network architecture, connectivity, identity federation, and infrastructure management.
* **Containers and Platforms:**
  Kubernetes, container orchestration, and platform operations.
* **Automation and DevOps:**
  Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, configuration management, and automated provisioning.
* **Monitoring and Observability:**
  Monitoring, logging, observability platforms, SIEM integration, and performance management.
* **Cybersecurity:**
  Identity and Access Management (IAM), privileged access management, vulnerability management, security posture management, data protection, and disaster recovery.
* **Cloud Operations and Management:**
  IT Service Management (ITSM), incident management, problem management, change management, service availability, and operational governance.
* **FinOps:**
  Cloud cost management, consumption monitoring, budgeting, forecasting, and resource optimization.
* Proven experience managing multi-vendor environments, program budgets, technical dependencies, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience developing operating models, governance frameworks, RACI matrices, SLAs, and operational transition plans.
* Experience in telecommunications, government, or large-enterprise environments is an advantage.

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP, PgMP, or PRINCE2.
* ITIL Foundation or higher.
* Agile or SAFe certifications.
* Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or Oracle Cloud certifications.
* Kubernetes or cloud architecture certifications.
* FinOps certification.
* Cybersecurity or enterprise architecture certifications.

Title: Sr. Director, Infrastructure Operations
Description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.
  
  
What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Position Summary (Purpose of job):**
The Senior Director,
**Enterprise Infrastructure Operations**
is accountable for the stability, performance, security, and cost-effectiveness of all enterprise infrastructure services across on-premises and cloud environments. This role ensures operational excellence for compute, storage, backup, and cloud-hosted workloads, while leading managed service providers (MSPs) and internal teams to deliver reliable, secure, and compliant services at scale.
  
  
This leader owns Infrastructure Operations, ensuring services are resilient, measurable, and continuously improved to meet business and clinical needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own End-to-End Infrastructure Operations:
* Accountable for day-to-day operations of compute, storage, backup, and cloud infrastructure services.
* Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of all infrastructure platforms supporting business-critical systems.
* Establish and enforce operational standards, procedures, and runbooks.
* Lead incident, problem, and change management practices with a focus on minimizing business disruption.
* Drive Operational Excellence & Service Reliability:
* Define and manage SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs for infrastructure services.
* Implement proactive monitoring, alerting, and capacity management across all platforms.
* Lead root cause analysis and ensure permanent resolution of recurring issues.
* Continuously improve operational maturity, automation, and service quality.
* MSP & Partner Operational Governance:
* Own the performance and accountability of Managed Service Providers (MSPs).
* Establish clear operating models, KPIs, and governance cadences with service providers.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, contractual obligations, and service quality expectations.
* Partner with Vendor Management Office / Sourcing & Procurement on renewals, performance management, and cost optimization.
* Infrastructure Security, Risk & Compliance:
* Ensure infrastructure operations comply with cybersecurity policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Lead remediation of vulnerabilities, patching compliance, and audit findings.
* Partner with Security and Risk teams to strengthen operational resilience and reduce exposure.
* Maintain audit readiness across all infrastructure domains.
* Cloud & Hybrid Workload Operations:
* Oversee operational management of workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Ensure consistent operational practices across on-prem and cloud platforms.
* Optimize cloud operations for performance, and scalability.
* Partner with Cloud Platforms and Infrastructure Engineering teams on transition to operations for newly deployed services.
* Financial & Capacity Management:
* Own infrastructure operational budgets, including partners consumption-based services.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives across compute, storage, backup, and cloud.
* Provide transparency into cost drivers, forecasting, and allocation.
* Align capacity planning with business demand and growth.
* Documentation, Observability & Reporting:
* Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation of infrastructure services, configurations, and dependencies.
* Deliver operational dashboards and executive reporting on performance, risks, and trends.
* Provide actionable insights on capacity, utilization, and service health.
* Leadership & Organizational Development:
* Build and lead a high-performing operations organization, including internal teams and external partners.
* Define clear roles and accountability between internal staff and MSPs.
* Develop leadership capability within the team, particularly in operational discipline and service management.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

**Minimum Requirements:**
Education/Training –
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree or professional certifications in related areas preferred.

**Critical Skills:**

* 12+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure operations, including leadership roles overseeing large-scale, hybrid (on-prem and cloud) environments.
* Strong understanding of IT financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization.
* Broad knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies, with depth in compute, storage, backup, and cloud platforms, and the ability to govern complex environments.
* Proven experience managing hybrid and cloud operations (preferably Microsoft Azure), including workload operations, cost control, and performance management.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure operations disciplines: monitoring, patching, capacity management, incident/problem/change management.
* Working knowledge of legacy platforms (e.g. IBMi (OS/400) / AS/400 environments) to ensure operational continuity and risk management.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure security, risk, and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, SOC 1&2), including audit readiness and vulnerability remediation.
* Demonstrated experience in MSP/vendor management, including defining SLAs, driving performance, and holding partners accountable for outcomes.
* Strong leadership skills with experience building and leading operations-focused teams, including managing internal staff and external providers.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence and service reliability in complex, large-scale environments.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at executive and operational levels.
* Experience leading in highly complex, matrixed organizations, driving alignment across infrastructure, security, and application teams.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL / IT Service Management practices (incident, problem, change, service level management).
* Relevant certifications (cloud, ITIL, infrastructure technologies) are an asset; emphasis on operational leadership over technical specialization.

**Working Conditions:**
Environment (Office) –
  
  

* Traditional office environment.
* Hybrid work type.

Physical Requirements (Lifting, standing, etc.) –
  
  

* Large percent of time performing computer-based work is required.

Description:
**The Klick Group**
—comprising Klick Health (including Oxford PharmaGenesis, Klick Katalyst, and btwelve), Klick Media, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), and Klick Consulting—is an ecosystem dedicated help life sciences brands achieve their full potential through best-in-class marketing and advertising, media, medical affairs and communications, market access, real-world evidence, and technology and analytics consulting — powered by 500+ in-house medical experts and award-winning data science and AI capabilities. Founded in 1997, we have offices in Toronto, New York, Oxford, London, Cambridge, Cardiff, Melbourne, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, São Paulo, and Singapore. One of the most-awarded health agencies on the planet, Klick is consistently recognized for its people-first culture as a Great Place to Work, Best Workplace for Women, Best Workplace for Inclusion, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and FORTUNE Best Workplace in Advertising. Klick also recently made history as Cannes Lions Healthcare Agency of the Year, Healthcare Network of the Year, and Independent Agency of the Year – Health.
  
  
**About Our Technology Craft**

Technology teams transform ideas into functional, future-ready solutions. Their work supports both client delivery and internal growth.
  
  
**Job Description**

This role oversees multidisciplinary Klick teams, offshore partners, and vendor-supported delivery pods while managing service-level agreements (SLAs), incident response, resource capacity, and commercial performance. * Direct incident management and monitoring practices, including severity classification, alert thresholds, event routing, on-call schedules, escalation policies, notification workflows, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews to improve response performance and reduce recurring incidents.

* Govern SOWs, change requests, and commercial delivery performance by tracking scope, assumptions, budgets, actual costs, margins, and utilization while supporting solution development, pricing, renewals, and early identification of delivery risks.
* Lead client service reviews, executive escalations, and remediation planning while developing standardized delivery playbooks, reporting tools, and operational processes, and coaching delivery managers, project leads, and engineers to improve delivery consistency and team performance.

* Experience designing and configuring service monitoring and incident response workflows, including alert thresholds, event routing, notification channels, on-call schedules, escalation policies, runbooks, and regular testing or optimization of monitoring effectiveness.
* Experience managing offshore or third-party delivery partners, including SLA governance, performance reviews, resource forecasting, capacity planning, and coordination of distributed teams across client engagements.
* Experience managing SOWs, change requests, project budgets, margins, and resource utilization, with demonstrated ability to report commercial performance, manage delivery risks, and communicate recommendations to senior clients or executive stakeholders.

**Desired:**

* Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
* Experience delivering IT managed services or technology programs within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
* Experience configuring or managing service delivery platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or comparable ticketing and IT service management systems, including service reporting or workflow automation.
* Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, or incident response solutions using PagerDuty, SolarWinds, or comparable platforms, with examples of improved alert quality, incident response, or operational visibility.
* ITIL, PMP, or comparable service management or project delivery certification, supported by practical application of structured service management or delivery methodologies.

Title: Vice President Service Delivery
Description:
**Position Summary**

Nuvollo is a rapidly growing managed services provider (MSP) of approximately 100 employees, delivering managed IT services including help desk, private cloud hosting (general-purpose Windows servers and ERP hosting), managed security services, professional services, AI consulting and security/governance — to small, mid-market & enterprise commercial clients across the United States and Canada. With primary offices in Cedar Knolls, New Jersey and Toronto, Ontario, a mix of US office-based/hybrid/remote & an offshore workforce providing 24x7 coverage, and growth through both organic expansion and planned tuck-in acquisitions of smaller MSPs, Nuvollo requires disciplined, scalable, and consistently excellent service delivery.

Reporting to the CEO, the
**Vice President, Service Delivery**
owns the end-to-end delivery of all managed, professional, cloud, and internal IT services. This executive leads a multi-site, cross-border organization comprising two regional Client Experience (help desk) teams (US and Canada), a Professional Services team (onboarding/offboarding, project management, project implementation, and support escalations), a Cloud Operations team (private cloud hosting in Nuvollo datacenters), and internal IT systems support and administration. The VP is accountable for client satisfaction, service quality (SLA’s), operational efficiency, service margin, and the scalability of the delivery platform — ensuring service delivery keeps pace with rapid organic and acquisition-driven growth while maintaining a unified, high-standard client experience across both countries. The VP is also responsible for full management of the Nuvollo’s PSA, RMM, and all other internal systems and plays a significant role in assisting with response to the annual SOC 2 Type 2 Audit.

This is a hands-on executive role appropriate to a ~100-person and growing organization: the VP is expected to remain close to operations, coach and develop a team of four direct leaders (plus an individual-contributor internal IT systems administrator), and personally drive key initiatives such as acquisition integration, service delivery standardization, and delivery tooling and automation. The VP, Service Delivery is an active member of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), participating in setting the overall strategic direction of the business. They will also participate in company Board meetings monthly.

**Reporting Relationships and Organizational Context**

* **Reports to:**
  Chief Executive Officer.
* **Direct reports:**
  Toronto Regional Client Experience Manager; New Jersey Regional Client Experience Manager; Director of Professional Services; Cloud Operations Manager; Internal IT Systems Administrator.
* **Organization led:**
  Approximately 70 delivery professionals across Canada, the US, India, and Pakistan spanning help desk, professional services, cloud operations, and internal IT.
* **Peer relationships:**
  Finance/HR; Technology and Innovation (vendor/tech stack selection and solution design); Commercial (sales and marketing).
* **Locations:**
  New Jersey (primary US office), Toronto (primary Canadian office), with remote and hybrid team members across both countries, India & Pakistan.
* **Classification:**
  Full-time, executive (FLSA-exempt / Ontario-exempt); hybrid working arrangement with regular presence in the New Jersey and Toronto offices and periodic travel between sites, datacenters, and acquired-company locations. Note: Travel cross-border between US and Canada is expected to be no more than 1-2x per quarter.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

***Service Delivery Leadership and Operational Excellence***

* Own the full lifecycle of service delivery across all service lines and both countries. Partner with Tech & Innovation team to establish and enforce standardized, documented, and repeatable delivery processes, standard operating procedures, and a consistent service catalog across US and Canadian operations. Ensure services are delivered on time, on budget, and to contractual SLA and quality standards.

***Client Experience and Satisfaction***

* Champion a client-first, high sense of urgency culture across both regional help desk teams. Ensure consistent, high-quality, 24x7-responsive support for clients globally, with clear escalation paths from tier-1 through professional services. Own the client satisfaction program — surveys, complaint resolution, and churn-risk intervention — including partnering with VP Commercial for retention strategies for at-risk accounts, and growth strategies for strategic accounts.

***SLA and Service Level Management***

* Define, negotiate (with Commercial), monitor, and consistently meet/exceed client SLAs and internal operational targets. Maintain robust service level reporting, breach and failure root-cause analysis, and corrective action programs. Ensure contractual commitments are realistic, profitable, and operationally achievable across time zones and borders.

***Cloud Operations and Infrastructure Reliability***

* Directly accountable, through the Cloud Operations Manager, for the private cloud hosting business: datacenter operations, Windows server and ERP hosting platforms, proper licensing, capacity planning, high availability, disaster recovery, backup integrity, and infrastructure security posture. Ensure platform reliability, uptime, governance and cost efficiency that support both client commitments and healthy service margins.

***Professional Services and Onboarding Excellence***

* Through the Director of Professional Services, own client onboarding and offboarding, project management, and professional services for project implementation. Drive fast, high-quality, consistent and standardized low-risk onboarding that accelerates time-to-value and revenue recognition, and ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and with high client acceptance. Own the escalation framework from the help desk teams into professional services and engineering resources. Own Project Management Office (PMO) for all all internal and client facing projects.

***Acquisition Integration and Scalable Growth***

* Lead the service delivery dimension of tuck-in MSP acquisitions: due diligence on delivery operations, integration planning and execution, standardization of tooling, processes, and service catalogs, retention of key technical and service staff, and rapid migration of acquired clients onto Nuvollo platforms and SLAs — while protecting the client experience of both acquired and existing clients.
* Active participant in pre-acquisition diligence and post-acquisition integration efforts.

***Team Leadership, Development, and Cross-Border Management***

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing, engaged, dispersed delivery organization across the US, Canada, India and Pakistan. Set clear goals and accountability for direct reports; develop succession plans and career paths; foster a unified culture across geographic and national boundaries; and manage performance, hiring, and staffing levels to meet demand. Ensure effective scheduling, coverage, and workload balancing across time zones.

* ***Financial and Capacity Management***

Own the service delivery staffing budget. Partner with Finance on revenue recognition, project accounting, and cost allocation; partner with Commercial on scoping, pricing, and serviceability of new deals; partner with Tech & Innovation team on identification and definition of new services and standardized implementation and delivery processes, vendor partners and tech stack tools.

***Process Improvement, Automation, and AI Enablement***

* Drive continuous improvement across all delivery functions using metrics, root-cause analysis, and client feedback. Champion automation, AI-assisted support tooling, and self-service capabilities to improve response times, reduce cost-to-serve, and scale delivery capacity ahead of growth. Partner with Technology and Innovation on tooling and platform selection and on embedding AI consulting and governance practices into delivery.

***Security, Compliance, and Risk Management***

* Ensure delivery operations meet client contractual, regulatory, and cybersecurity obligations across both jurisdictions (e.g., cyber insurance requirements, privacy laws such as PIPEDA and state privacy statutes, and frameworks such as SOC 2 where applicable). Own operational incident and major outage management, including client communications, post-incident reviews, and remediation. Partner with Tech and Innovation leadership to ensure the security of Nuvollo’s own environment and hosted client infrastructure.

**Qualifications and Experience**

***Required***

* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, managed services, or IT operations, including 5+ years in senior leadership roles within an MSP, hosting provider, or comparable IT services environment.
* Proven leadership of multi-site, dispersed teams of 40+, with demonstrated success managing remote/hybrid organizations across time zones and national borders.

Title: Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations
Industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
Description:
**Job Description**
The Director, IT Infrastructure and Operations leads the teams that keep Liquidity Services’ technology operating reliably every day: Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support. This role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability, and cost-effectiveness of end-user support; server, identity, collaboration, backup, and storage platforms across on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments; and the hybrid network that connects offices, retail locations, warehouse facilities, cloud environments, and remote users. As a hands-on technical leader, the Director sets operational standards and service levels, serves as the senior escalation point for infrastructure and network issues, builds and develops the team, manages vendors and budgets, and leads modernization efforts in partnership with Information Security, DevOps, application teams, and business leaders. Based in the Dallas area, the Director works on-site at the Richardson, TX office several days a week and serves as the senior IT operations leader for that location.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Service availability: Uptime of critical infrastructure, network, and end-user services meets defined targets.
* Service Desk performance: Response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, backlog, and employee satisfaction meet agreed service levels.
* Security and compliance: Servers, endpoints, and network devices are kept current on security patches, vulnerabilities are remediated on schedule, and infrastructure controls pass PCI and SOX audits.
* Resilience: Backups and disaster recovery are tested regularly and meet defined recovery goals.
* Modernization delivery: The infrastructure and network roadmap is executed on schedule and within budget, including removing the dependency on Cisco cloud services routers and delivering new facility builds and site upgrades.
* Financial management: Infrastructure, cloud, telecom, and support spending is managed within budget, with measurable licensing, cloud, and vendor cost savings.
* Team strength: Strong retention, development, and coverage of critical skills across all three teams.
* Lead, manage, and develop the Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support teams, including hiring, goal setting, performance management, coaching, and succession planning.
* Set the strategy and multi-year roadmap for end-user support, infrastructure, and network services, aligned with business priorities, security requirements, and the company’s cloud direction.
* Oversee Service Desk and Field Support operations through the Service Desk Director, including field services across offices, retail locations, and warehouse facilities, and set expectations for service levels, escalation paths, staffing and coverage models, and self-service and knowledge-management practices.
* Own the implementation, delivery, and support of enterprise server and identity platforms, including Windows Server, virtualization platforms, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), ADFS, and DNS/DHCP.
* Own the Microsoft 365 collaboration stack, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams, and the endpoint management platforms that support it.
* Oversee cloud infrastructure across multiple Azure regions and the AWS environment, in partnership with DevOps and application teams.
* Own backup and disaster recovery using Rubrik and Azure Site Recovery, including regular recovery testing, documentation, and business continuity planning.
* Govern enterprise file shares and data storage policies, including retention, PII, access, and user roles, with regular access and integrity audits in partnership with Information Security.
* Drive cloud cost optimization with Server, Development, DevOps, and Database teams using native cloud cost tools.
* Oversee the hybrid network environment, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls and VPN, WAN and internet connectivity, and the program to replace Cisco cloud services routers with cloud-native connectivity between Azure, AWS, and company sites.
* Own infrastructure and network monitoring and alerting (such as PRTG and Datadog), so that issues are detected and resolved before they affect the business.
* Lead IT delivery for new facilities, expansions, relocations, and site upgrades, coordinating network, infrastructure, end-user equipment, and Service Desk readiness.
* Establish and run IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, asset, and request management; lead major-incident response and post-incident reviews, and serve as the senior escalation point for infrastructure issues.
* Serve as the primary liaison between Platform Operations and the Security and Site Reliability (SSRE) team; partner with Information Security on patching, vulnerability remediation, access controls, logging, and segmentation, and support PCI, SOX, and other audit and control requirements.
* Define operational metrics and dashboards, and report service performance, risks, and project status to IT leadership and business stakeholders.
* Develop and manage the infrastructure, cloud, network, telecom, and support budgets; drive cost optimization across licensing, cloud consumption, carriers, and hardware.
* Manage relationships with key vendors, carriers, managed service providers, and contractors; partner with the Contracts team on negotiations, renewals, and service-performance reviews.
* Champion automation, standardization, and documentation to improve reliability and reduce manual work.
* Serve as the senior IT infrastructure leader on-site at the Richardson, TX office and as the escalation point for after-hours critical incidents.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Team or Function Manager: This position manages a team or function and is responsible for hiring, performance management, employee development, and ensuring work is completed in alignment with organizational objectives.
* Directly manages the leaders and senior individual contributors responsible for Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support, including the Service Desk Director who leads help desk and field support technicians.
* Provides second-level leadership for help desk analysts and field support technicians, ensuring consistent service levels, escalation practices, performance expectations, and employee experience across locations.
* Responsible for hiring, performance management, development, and staffing decisions for these teams, and for oversight of contractors and managed service providers supporting these functions.

**Qualifications**
**Education/ Experience**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of experience and certifications.
* Ten or more years of progressively responsible IT infrastructure and operations experience, including at least five years managing technical teams.
* Hands-on background in Microsoft server and identity infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365, in an organization with at least 1,000 employees is preferred.
* Experience leading multiple IT functions, such as platform operations, network engineering, and service desk and field support, in a distributed, multi-site organization.
* Demonstrated success delivering infrastructure, network, or cloud modernization programs.
* Deep knowledge of Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), ADFS, DNS/DHCP, and Windows and Azure security best practices.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams.
* Experience with virtualization platforms, enterprise storage, backup and recovery tools such as Rubrik, and/or Azure Site Recovery.
* Experience with Azure and AWS infrastructure and networking in a hybrid environment.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise networking and network security, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls, VPN, and WAN connectivity.
* Experience leading a Service Desk and IT service management team with defined service levels using an ITSM platform.
* Budget ownership and vendor management experience, including contract negotiation and telecom carrier management.
* Working knowledge of PCI, SOX, and related control and audit requirements.
* Experience with monitoring platforms such as Data Dog, PRTG, or similar enterprise monitoring and observability tools.
* PowerShell scripting, infrastructure-as-code, and automation experience.
* Experience with cloud-native network transit architectures, such as AWS Transit Gateway and Azure Virtual WAN, and migration away from virtual router appliances.
* ITIL 4 certification or equivalent IT service management training.
* Experience supporting retail, warehouse, or logistics operations, and managing geographically distributed, field, or contracted support teams.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Solutions Architect, AWS, CCNP, PMP, or CISSP.

**Skills And Ability**

* Strong leader who builds accountable, high-performing teams
* Hands-on technical depth to step in on complex escalations
* Ability to balance day-to-day operational demands with long-term strategic initiatives and to manage multiple priorities under pressure
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication with technical teams, executives, and business stakeholders
* Sound judgment and composure when leading critical incidents
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, planning, and prioritization skills
* Customer-service mindset focused on the employee experience

**Work Conditions/ Physical Demands**

* This position is primarily in a home office or at the Richardson, TX office. The employee is expected to maintain a safe, secure, and distraction-free workspace with reliable internet access. Duties primarily involve prolonged periods of sitting, working on a computer, and communicating via phone and video conferencing.
* The employee must be able to frequently use a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment, as well as communicate effectively with colleagues, customers, and business partners. Occasional lifting of office materials or equipment up to 15 pounds may be required.
* Availability for after-hours escalation of critical incidents and planned maintenance.
* Periodic visits to warehouses and retail facilities, which may involve noise, temperature variation, and active equipment.

**Travel**

* Occasional travel may be required for meetings, training, or business needs (up to 10%).

**Pay & Benefits**
Compensation is determined by various factors such as location, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as internal and external equity and organizational needs. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Title: Network Operations Center Manager
Description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Network Operations Center (NOC) Manager is responsible for establishing and managing a high-performing, 24/7 operational support organization responsible for monitoring infrastructure, managing customer support requests, coordinating incident response, and ensuring exceptional service delivery.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring a combination of technical expertise, operational discipline, customer service leadership, and organizational development.

The NOC Manager will initially focus on building the Austin NOC operation, including recruiting personnel, establishing staffing schedules, implementing operating procedures, defining escalation processes, and developing the tools and reporting necessary to manage a growing global infrastructure environment.

Once operational, the NOC Manager will have direct accountability for the performance of the NOC, including ticket response times, ticket resolution coordination, incident escalation, customer communications, shift coverage, and operational reporting.

A primary responsibility of this position is ensuring that every customer support ticket receives timely attention, accurate classification, appropriate escalation, consistent follow-through, and documented resolution.

The NOC Manager must establish a culture in which tickets are actively managed from creation through closure, regardless of which technical department is responsible for performing the underlying work.

The successful candidate will understand that the NOC is not simply a monitoring organization. It is the central coordination point for customer-impacting operational issues across Cirrascale's infrastructure.

The NOC Manager will work closely with Engineering, Data Center Operations, Infrastructure Deployment, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, Hardware Support, and RMA personnel to ensure issues are resolved efficiently and customers remain informed.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**NOC Development, Organization, Leadership, and Change Management**

* Lead the establishment and operational development of Cirrascale's Network Operations Center in Austin, Texas.
* Develop the organizational structure required to support continuous 24/7/365 infrastructure monitoring and customer support.
* Participate in recruiting, interviewing, selecting, onboarding, and training NOC personnel.
* Establish staffing requirements, shift schedules, and coverage plans based on ticket volumes, infrastructure growth, and customer service commitments.
* Develop structured onboarding and training programs to ensure employees can perform their responsibilities consistently and independently.
* Establish shift turnover procedures to ensure continuity of operations and communication of unresolved incidents, open tickets, customer commitments, and operational risks.
* Build a culture of accountability, professionalism, technical competency, teamwork, and exceptional customer service.
* Conduct performance reviews, coaching sessions, and employee development activities.
* Establish and oversee operational change management processes for production infrastructure.
* Ensure the NOC has visibility into scheduled maintenance, approved infrastructure changes, and anticipated service impacts.
* Ensure monitoring, documentation, escalation contacts, and support procedures are established before new systems, infrastructure expansions, and customer deployments are transitioned into production.
* Establish procedures for identifying, monitoring, and escalating incidents associated with recent infrastructure changes.

**Ticket Management and Service Desk Operations**

Ticket management is the primary responsibility of the NOC Manager. The individual must maintain complete operational visibility into customer and internal support activities.

* Oversee the complete lifecycle of all customers and internally generated operational support tickets.
* Continuously monitor ticket queues for unassigned, aging, stalled, improperly prioritized, or unresolved tickets.
* Establish response-time, escalation, and resolution expectations consistent with customer service-level agreements.
* Ensure tickets are properly documented and not closed prematurely or without adequate resolution.
* Establish escalation procedures for tickets exceeding response or resolution targets.
* Establish standardized ticket documentation requirements, including troubleshooting steps, technical findings, escalation history, customer communications, and final resolution.
* Identify recurring ticket categories and coordinate corrective actions to reduce repeat issues.
* Establish procedures for reopening tickets when reported issues have not been fully resolved.

The NOC Manager must understand ticket volumes, backlog conditions, outstanding customer issues, assigned ownership, and the actions being taken to resolve them at any given time.

**Incident Management, Operational Escalation, Planned Maintenance**

* Establish and manage incident detection, classification, response, escalation, and resolution procedures.
* Develop clearly defined incident severity levels and escalation requirements.
* Ensure critical incidents receive immediate attention and are escalated according to established procedures.
* Coordinate incident response across Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, Data Center Operations, and external service providers.
* Serve as an operational escalation point during significant service interruptions.
* Maintain clear accountability for incident ownership, response coordination, and resolution.
* Ensure incident activities are documented accurately, including timelines, actions taken, communications, and resolution details.
* Coordinate post-incident reviews and root cause analysis with the appropriate technical teams.
* Track corrective actions resulting from incidents and ensure identified problems are addressed.
* Ensure unresolved incidents are appropriately communicated during shift transitions and customer-impacting incidents receive proper follow-up.
* Manage and monitor the planned maintenance schedule across all sites and ensure customers are notified and go smoothly.
* Coordinate customer notifications and internal communications associated with planned maintenance and infrastructure changes.

**Cross-Functional Operational Coordination**

The NOC serves as a central coordination function within Cirrascale's Operations organization. The NOC manager owns this piece.

* Coordinate with Network Engineering on connectivity issues, network outages, routing problems, and equipment failures.
* Work with Systems Engineering on server failures, operating system issues, and hardware-related incidents.
* Coordinate with Data Center Operations and remote technicians for physical troubleshooting and hardware replacement activities.
* Work with RMA and hardware support personnel to track failed components, replacement parts, and repair activities.
* Participate in operational readiness reviews for new customer deployments and infrastructure expansions.
* Ensure operational documentation, monitoring requirements, and escalation contacts are available before new environments transition to NOC support.
* Identify recurring problems requiring action by Engineering or other operational departments.
* Escalate unresolved interdepartmental dependencies to Operations leadership when necessary.

**Operational Procedures, Documentation, and Knowledge Management**

* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for routine NOC activities.
* Establish documented troubleshooting, incident response, and escalation procedures.
* Create and maintain technical runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and operational reference materials.
* Ensure NOC personnel have access to accurate infrastructure documentation and support contacts.
* Establish procedures for reviewing and updating documentation as infrastructure and operational requirements change.
* Incorporate lessons learned from incidents and operational reviews into established procedures.
* Maintain standardized documentation requirements for ticket handling, shift turnover, incident communication, and escalation.
* Ensure operational knowledge is shared across shifts rather than concentrated among individual employees.

**Security, Compliance, and Operational Controls**

* Ensure NOC activities comply with Cirrascale security policies and operational requirements.
* Support the company's information security and compliance programs, including applicable SOC 2 and ISO requirements.
* Maintain appropriate access controls and operational procedures for monitoring and support systems.
* Ensure security-related alerts and incidents are escalated to designated security personnel.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, changes, and operational activities when required for audit purposes.
* Ensure NOC personnel understand security responsibilities and escalation requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by providing appropriate operational documentation and evidence.
* Identify operational control deficiencies and coordinate corrective actions.

**Technical Operations**

* Provide Level 1/Level 2 technical support and escalation for complex incidents.
* Oversee troubleshooting of LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, and internet connectivity issues.
* Monitor network availability, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization, and device health.
* Troubleshoot routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and connectivity-related issues.
* Oversee monitoring of firewalls, routers, switches, load balancers, and wireless infrastructure.
* Coordinate with network, systems, security, cloud, and application teams.
* Support infrastructure changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities.
* Review network performance trends and identify potential capacity or availability risks.
* Linux and Windows server operating environments.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation technologies, including Python, Bash, PowerShell

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline preferred.
* Equivalent professional experience may substitute for formal education.
* Advanced education or relevant technical certifications are beneficial but not mandatory.

**LEADERSHIP AND PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

The successful candidate must demonstrate:

* **Customer Commitment:**
  A genuine commitment to exceptional customer service, recognizing that responsiveness, communication, and accountability are essential to customer satisfaction.
* **Operational Ownership:**
  A willingness to take responsibility for problems and actively coordinate their resolution, even when technical work is performed by another department.
* **Leadership:**
  The ability to establish expectations, develop employees, address performance deficiencies, and build a professional, accountable team.
* **Technical Judgment:**
  The ability to evaluate operational issues, recognize their severity, and determine when additional technical expertise or management escalation is required.
* **Communication:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems clearly to customers, engineers, and senior management.
* **Organization:**
  The ability to manage competing priorities, monitor multiple operational issues, and maintain accurate visibility into outstanding work.
* **Decision-Making:**
  The ability to make sound decisions under pressure, particularly during customer-impacting incidents.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  A disciplined approach to ticket documentation, escalation tracking, operational procedures, and customer commitments.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  A proactive approach to identifying operational weaknesses and implementing practical improvements.
* **Professionalism:**
  The ability to represent Cirrascale effectively when interacting with customers, vendors, employees, and executive leadership.

**Salary Range**

The base salary range for the
**Manager, NOC**
is $108,000 to $120,000 USD. This pay range reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay range for this job for the location for which it has been posted. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

**Benefits**

Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and opportunities for professional development.

**Why Join Cirrascale?**

Join a growing team that's pushing the boundaries of AI infrastructure. At Cirrascale, you’ll contribute to projects powering next-generation AI applications while working with top-tier hardware in a collaborative and innovative environment. From custom deployments to hands-on customer support, every role here plays a part in enabling breakthroughs in AI.

Title: Major Incident Manager, Incident Management
Description:
**Responsibilities**
The USDS JV Incident Management Team (IMT) is a critical pillar within the US Tech and Product organization, dedicated to ensuring the resilience and reliability of TikTok’s U.S. Data Security infrastructure. As a security-first division, we focus on providing specialized oversight and protection for U.S. user data and the platforms that support them.
  
While global teams monitor overall service health, the IMT is uniquely positioned to manage the "blast radius" within the USDS environment. We act as the bridge between technical engineering teams (SRE, Infrastructure, Platform) and business stakeholders, ensuring that every major incident is handled with the precision and urgency required by our unique operating environment.
  
  
As a Major Incident Manager, you will be at the forefront of protecting the TikTok experience for millions of users. You will join a cohesive, proficient team committed to upholding the highest standards of professionalism and technical expertise, directly contributing to the safety and security of the U.S. digital ecosystem.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
- Incident Command: Lead the end-to-end response for high-severity incidents, driving rapid restoration of service while coordinating across cross-functional engineering teams.
  
- Stakeholder Communication: Craft and deliver clear, timely, and accurate communication updates to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and customer-facing teams during critical events.
  
- Post-Incident Reviews: Facilitate blameless post-mortems, ensuring root causes are thoroughly identified, actionable remediation items are tracked, and lessons learned are shared globally.
  
- Dashboarding & Visibility: Create and maintain real-time operational dashboards that provide high visibility into system health, incident trends, and key reliability metrics (MTTD/MTTR).
  
- Continuous Improvement: Analyze incident data and operational metrics to identify systemic trends, driving initiatives to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).

- Automation Engineering: Design and build automated workflows to streamline incident response, such as automated stakeholder communications, auto-remediation scripts, and tool integrations.
  
- Oncall Support: This position provides on-call support and requires working scheduled shifts, which may include holidays. The scheduled shift is Sunday to Thursday, from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM PT.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience) with 4+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern infrastructure architectures (microservices, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).
