- Ability to write scripts (e.g., Bash, Python) or use low-code integration tools to automate repetitive incident management tasks and notification pipelines.
  
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of translating deeply technical issues into clear business impact summaries for leadership.
  
- Strong working knowledge of ITIL incident management frameworks or modern DevOps/SRE incident response practices.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- 5+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Deep alignment with Google SRE principles, including Error Budgets, SLA/SLO/SLI management, and automation-first mindsets.
  
- Proven experience implementing ChatOps, auto-remediation workflows, or Event-Driven Ansible/Runbook automation to programmatically resolve common alerts.
  
- Advanced proficiency with modern incident orchestration platforms like PagerDuty, Opsgenie, JIRA Service Management, and Slack integrations.
  
- Experience using SQL, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools to build operational dashboards and report on organizational reliability metrics.
  
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL v4, AWS/GCP Certified Professional, or Certified Incident Commander.
  
- Experience coaching and training engineering teams on best practices for on-call hygiene and conducting constructive post-mortems.

Title: Senior Incident Manager
Description:
Crusoe is on a mission
*to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*
. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.
  
  
We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.
  
  
We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.
  
  
If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.
  
  
**About This Role:**
As a Senior Incident Manager at Crusoe, you'll lead the response when things go wrong, coordinating the right people across teams, driving urgency, and keeping everyone focused until customer-impacting issues are resolved. You'll own communication throughout that process, including internal updates that keep responders coordinated and leadership informed, and status page decisions that keep customers informed. Once an incident is resolved, you'll drive the post-incident review process, ensuring postmortems are written and debriefs are held on time, then translate those findings into a clear, customer-facing root cause analysis (RCA) that builds lasting trust with enterprise customers and executives. You'll also maintain the incident metrics and reporting that show how we're performing, and ensure preventative actions coming out of incidents are properly documented and tracked.
  
  
In this full-time position, you'll have the opportunity to shape and enhance our incident management processes as the team and company scale, improving how we detect, respond to, and learn from incidents. The ideal candidate combines strong incident coordination fundamentals with real experience writing customer-facing root cause analysis to enterprise customers, plus the analytical rigor to track and report on incident data, and basic technical fluency to engage credibly with infrastructure teams, without needing to be the one troubleshooting.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Working On:**

* Incident Response Leadership: Lead end-to-end management of high-visibility technical incidents and enterprise customer escalations, ensuring rapid restoration of services and effective communication throughout the lifecycle.
* Incident Coordination: Coordinate the response effort across teams during an incident — you won't be troubleshooting the technical issue yourself, but you'll work closely with responders to determine which teams are needed and ensure everyone stays focused in the right direction.
* Strategic Collaboration: Act as a critical bridge between Customer Success and internal engineering/product teams, translating frontline feedback into actionable incident response steps.
* Customer Communication & Judgment: Own status page communications — determining the right level of detail and the best way to frame updates so customers get clear, useful information. This requires more judgment at a startup, where communication practices are still being defined, versus larger, more established companies.
* RCA Ownership: Own end-to-end production of customer-facing root cause analyses — translating incident data into clear, structured writing for enterprise customers and executives.
* Corrective Action Documentation: Ensure proper documentation of internal corrective actions coming out of incidents, driving improvements to the reliability of our products and platform.
* Incident Metrics & Reporting: Maintain and report on core incident metrics (response time, resolution time, time to RCA delivery), ensuring incident data is accurate and complete.
* Knowledge Empowerment: Develop and deliver training materials, internal documentation, and knowledge base articles for teammates and customers.
* Process Innovation: Design and implement incident response strategies and self-serve support processes to scale the function as the team grows.
* On-Call Participation: Participate in on-call rotation, 10am–10pm coverage, 5 days per week, providing a reliable safety net for critical service interruptions.

Title: Cloud Operations Manager (Remote US)
Description:
Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise. Our exceptional experience across Applications, Data & AI, DevOps, Security, and the Microsoft Azure platform enables organizations to accelerate innovation, enhance security, and optimize operational agility. As a Microsoft Partner with seven specializations, GitHub AI Partner of the Year, a member of the GitHub Advisory Board, and a member of the prestigious Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA), Atmosera expertly delivers cutting-edge, integrated solutions that deliver business value.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
We measure success by results and alignment. Here is how we define a win for this role over your first year.
  
  
After 90 Days
  
  

* The Foundation: Develop a strong understanding of Atmosera's Client Operations organization, service delivery model, client portfolio, operational tooling, escalation paths, compliance requirements, and ITIL-based processes. Assess your team's capabilities, service performance, coverage model, operational health, and improvement opportunities.

Create clear expectations, accountability, communication rhythms, and partnership practices within your assigned function.
* The Contribution: Identify and begin executing a measurable operational improvement focused on an area such as queue health, backlog reduction, escalation quality, incident management, change management, automation, knowledge management, service coverage, or client experience.

After 1 Year
  
  

* Your Impact: Lead a high-performing operational team that consistently achieves its service objectives, contributes to strong client satisfaction, and supports operational excellence across Atmosera's managed services organization. Deliver measurable improvements in service performance, resolution quality, team capability, operational efficiency, and scalability.
* Your Growth: Be recognized as a trusted leader who successfully balances the needs of clients, employees, and the business. Build the technical, operational, and leadership capability of your team while developing future leaders and supporting meaningful career progression.
* Your Influence: Build strong partnerships across Client Operations and related departments, helping create repeatable operating practices, scalable processes, effective runbooks, automation opportunities, and service improvements that elevate the client experience and strengthen organizational effectiveness.

**The Skills Matrix**
Required Skills: The Non-Negotiables
  
  

* Years of Experience: Five or more years of experience in cloud operations, infrastructure operations, managed services, technical support, engineering, or service delivery, including at least three years directly managing technical teams.
* Role-Specific Mastery: Experience leading a technical support, service delivery, engineering, operations, or managed services team in a fast-paced environment. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud operations, with the technical depth and troubleshooting expertise to guide either a Technician team or an Administrator/Engineer team and earn credibility with technical employees and stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to hire, onboard, coach, evaluate, and develop employees; establish clear expectations and development plans; and support career progression and certification attainment.
* Operational Excellence: Experience owning service delivery for an assigned team in a 24x7 environment, including workforce and capacity planning, schedules, shift and on-call coverage, ticket health, workload management, and service quality. Ability to ensure work is prioritized, routed, documented, escalated, and resolved in line with service commitments; lead or support major incidents; enforce incident, problem, and change practices; maintain escalation paths, operating procedures, technical documentation, and client-specific runbooks; and ensure employees are trained and appropriately eligible, authorized, and assigned for regulated work. Sound judgment to balance urgency, quality, operational risk, coverage, and client communication under pressure, including the ability to pass a federal background check for Public Trust Fitness.
* Communication: Clear, calm, and effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to report KPIs, service performance, emerging risks, incident summaries, improvement priorities, and recommended actions to individual contributors, technical contacts, client executives, and internal leadership. Commitment to professional, timely communication during incidents, escalations, operational reviews, and service transitions.
* Collaboration: Experience partnering across operational teams and support functions to coordinate staffing, priorities, escalations, major incidents, service transitions, and continuous improvement. Ability to work closely with peer Client Operations leaders without blurring ownership of the assigned team; collaborate with Client Success, Professional Services, Security Operations, Security, and Compliance; support audits, evidence collection, and remediation; and provide temporary leadership coverage during vacations, leaves, on-call rotations, major incidents, and other business continuity situations.
* Problem Solving: Ability to use service and workforce data to identify trends, root causes, resource needs, and operational risks, then implement durable solutions that reduce repeat incidents and improve the client experience. Experience owning and reporting relevant KPIs, such as SLA attainment, response and resolution time, escalation rate, backlog, ticket aging, change success rate, service quality, automation adoption, and client satisfaction. Demonstrated ability to improve processes, tooling, training, monitoring, documentation, automation, or AI-assisted workflows while coordinating cross-team changes to avoid unintended downstream impacts.

**Nice to Have: The Bonus Points**

* Experience working for a managed services provider, ideally a Microsoft Azure Expert MSP.
* Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or other relevant Azure certifications.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or an advanced ITIL certification.
* Experience with Azure Lighthouse, Azure Monitor, Azure Arc, Azure Policy, Azure Automation, PowerShell, monitoring and alert tuning, AIOps, or Copilot-enabled workflows.
* Experience supporting FedRAMP, HIPAA, HITRUST, IRS-1075, or comparable regulated environments, including audit support and secure operating practices.
* Experience leading teams distributed across multiple time zones or countries.
* Knowledge of IT security practices and secure cloud operations.
* Experience with a ticketing or IT service management platform such as Zendesk or ServiceNow.

**How We Show Up**
These Core Three represent the heartbeat of Atmosera. They are the behaviors and attributes we align to every day, defining how we interact, solve problems, and celebrate our wins together. This is simply who we are at our best.
  
  

* Humble: Low Ego, High Impact. We share credit easily, admit when we're wrong, and view every mistake as a data point for growth.
* Hungry: Internal Drive. We have a natural bias for action. We don't wait for permission to solve a problem or find a better way to do things.
* Mindful: Intentional Awareness. We are conscious of our impact on the team. We listen more than we speak and respond to challenges with empathy and situational awareness.

**Our Interview Process**
We value your time and aim for transparency. Our typical interview process includes:
  
  

* Talent Screen: 30 minutes. A conversation about your background, leadership experience, career goals, and the mission of the role.
* Impact & Attributes Assessment: 45 minutes. A discussion focused on how you lead, solve problems, develop people, handle operational pressure, and demonstrate Atmosera's Core Three.
* Collaborator Loop: 60-90 minutes. Conversations with key partners focused on your technical and operational capabilities, service management experience, leadership approach, and ability to work across teams. This stage may include a presentation, scenario, or work sample.
* Final Alignment: 30 minutes. A closing conversation with leadership to align on expectations, organizational needs, and the impact of the role.

**Financial Security & Growth**
We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial security. Here's what you can look forward to:

Secure your financial future with our generous 401(k) plan, featuring a 100% company match on your contributions up to 4% of your salary! This is a fantastic opportunity to build your retirement savings with our support.

Your hard work and dedication will be recognized and rewarded through our performance-based compensation program, which includes bonus potential in addition to your base salary.
  
  
**Health & Well-being**

**Time Off & Work-Life Balance**
**Generous Paid Time Off (PTO):**
Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with three weeks of paid time off, allowing you to relax, recharge, and pursue your personal interests. This flexible PTO can be used for vacation, personal time, or sick leave.
  
  
**11 Paid Holidays:**
We observe 11 paid holidays throughout the year, giving you additional time to spend with family and friends.
  
  
**Community Service Leave:**

**Additional Perks & Recognition**
**Employee Recognition and Reward Program:**
We celebrate and reward outstanding performance and contributions through our employee recognition program. We value your dedication and are committed to showing our appreciation.
  
  
This is a full-time position in the United States with the ability to work from home, or from one of our many US offices if local.

Title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
Location: Doha, Qatar | Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
We are hiring a
**Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer**
to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an “automation-first” senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
  
  
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you’ll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products for software operation automation.
  
  
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical’s customers and the Ubuntu Community.
  
  
**As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will**

* Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
* Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
* Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
* Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
* Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
* Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical’s core services, networks, and infrastructure
* Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
* Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
* Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
* Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and ‘doing work together’
* Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
* A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
* Python software development experience, with large projects
* Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
* Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
* Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
* Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
* Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
* Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
* Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
* Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
* Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
* A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
* Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
* Happy to work within distributed teams
* Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer colleagues
  
  
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Title: Infrastructure Engineering Manager
Location: Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia | الرياض, S01, Saudi Arabia
Description:
**Job Description**
Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies.
  
  
We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big!
  
  
**Meet the team!**
Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team.
  
  
As an Infrastructure Engineering Manager at Unifonic, you will lead the engineering and operations of production cloud platforms, combining Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Platform Engineering, and AI-native engineering to ensure reliability, scalability, security, performance, and automation. You will remain hands-on by reviewing infrastructure code and architecture, troubleshooting complex production issues, working with Kubernetes and cloud services, and using AI engineering tools such as Claude Code daily. You will focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), with strong practical GCP expertise to support the ongoing migration to GCP, while collaborating with the Infrastructure Engineering Manager – Developer Experience, who is responsible for non-production environments, CI/CD, and developer tooling.
  
  
**Help Us Shape The Future Of Communication By**

* Owning the architecture, engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of production infrastructure across GCP and OCI.
* Taking a leading technical role in migrating production workloads to GCP.
* Designing highly available, scalable, resilient and secure production platforms.
* Setting engineering standards for compute, networking, storage, IAM and cloud-native services.
* Making sure the architecture meets availability, performance, capacity and disaster recovery requirements.
* Establishing consistent engineering patterns across GCP and OCI instead of treating each cloud as an isolated platform.
* Owning production Kubernetes platforms and their supporting ecosystem.
* Keeping clusters secure, observable, scalable, resilient and automated.
* Owning platform capabilities including ingress, service networking and service mesh, monitoring and logging.
* Working with application engineering teams to improve workload reliability and operational readiness.
* Building automation and self-service capabilities that reduce manual infrastructure work.
* Establishing and improving SRE practices across production infrastructure.
* Driving reliability through meaningful SLIs, SLOs, and operational metrics.
* Improving availability, capacity management and production resilience.
* Leading infrastructure-level troubleshooting during complex production incidents.
* Championing rigorous root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions.
* Reducing operational toil through engineering and automation.
* Improving monitoring, observability, and early detection of infrastructure problems.
* Building reliability into architecture and design, not only after incidents.
* Driving an Infrastructure-as-Code-first operating model.
* Keeping strong discipline around Terraform, reusable modules, automated validation and controlled production changes.
* Making sure infrastructure changes follow software engineering practice: source control, pull requests, peer review, testing and automated deployment.
* Using Bitbucket as the core of the infrastructure engineering workflow.
* Holding infrastructure repositories to the same standards as production application code.
* Embedding AI into daily infrastructure engineering, not as an occasional add-on.
* Using Claude Code to understand repositories, develop and review infrastructure code, investigate problems and automate workflows.
* Building and using MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that connect AI agents to infrastructure tooling.
* Applying AI to infrastructure monitoring, optimisation, incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
* Using AI to develop, validate and review Terraform.
* Defining where human validation and approval remain essential.
* Making sure AI is used safely around production systems, credentials and sensitive operational data.

Oversee critical production platform and backing services, including their lifecycle, standardisation, automation, availability, security, backup and disaster recovery:
  
  

* Databases and data infrastructure (for example MySQL, PostgreSQL)
* Caching (for example Redis)
* Messaging and middleware
* Kubernetes platform services
* Networking and connectivity
* IAM and secrets management
* Observability platforms
* Backup and recovery services
* Build security into infrastructure design and day-to-day engineering.
* Own IAM, network security, segmentation, secrets management and infrastructure hardening.
* Partner with Security Engineering on vulnerabilities and production risks.
* Make sure AI-assisted engineering follows security and governance controls.
* Keep infrastructure changes auditable through Infrastructure as Code and source control.
* Put guardrails and human oversight on production automation.
* Lead, mentor and grow a high-performing team of Infrastructure and SRE engineers.
* Stay technically credible: guide architecture, review solutions and join complex troubleshooting.
* Build a culture of engineering ownership rather than ticket handling.
* Challenge manual processes and find opportunities to automate.
* Drive adoption of AI-native engineering and coach engineers on Claude Code, MCP tooling and AI-assisted workflows.
* Partner with Product Engineering, Security and other teams on production platform strategy.
* Set clear engineering standards and keep documentation and knowledge sharing strong.

**Job Requirements**
**What you’ll bring:**

* 10+ years of experience across Infrastructure, Cloud, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or SRE.
* 3+ years of experience leading infrastructure, SRE, platform, or cloud engineering teams.
* Proven experience designing and operating highly available, production-grade cloud environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with production Kubernetes.
* Significant hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Strong understanding of networking, IAM, security, observability, and production operations.
* Experience leading a major infrastructure migration or platform transformation.
* Substantial hands-on experience designing, deploying, troubleshooting, and operating production workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Ability to discuss real-world GCP production architecture and operational decisions beyond theory or certifications.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and the ability to operate across both OCI and GCP.
* Daily, hands-on use of Claude Code in real engineering work.
* Practical understanding and use of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.
* Proven use of AI in software engineering, SRE, or infrastructure workflows beyond chat-style prompting.
* Ability to use AI effectively across large infrastructure and code repositories.

Title: Director of Service Delivery

The Director of Service Delivery will lead and scale a managed IT services organization, overseeing reactive support, escalated technical services, and service coordination teams. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, this role carries responsibility for service quality, operational performance, team development, and client satisfaction. The successful candidate will bring strong managed service provider (MSP) experience and a proven ability to manage complex service operations across multiple client environments. By optimizing technician capacity, ticket workflows, service levels, and operational processes, the Director will help improve efficiency while protecting profitability. The role also offers the opportunity to modernize service delivery through AI-powered tools and automation. This is a high-impact leadership position with significant influence over the organization's operational strategy and future growth.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  
The Director of Service Delivery will own the day-to-day performance and continuous improvement of the service organization, ensuring teams deliver reliable technical support while meeting client expectations and business objectives.
  
  

* Lead and develop the Reactive Service, Escalated Service, and Service Coordination teams, overseeing staffing, workload distribution, ticket lifecycles, and technician capacity.
* Manage escalations from initial routing through resolution, ensuring tickets are prioritized appropriately according to service-level agreements (SLAs) and escalation procedures.
* Monitor departmental performance against key performance indicators, including resolution times, customer satisfaction (CSAT), technician time utilization, and other operational metrics.
* Provide weekly reports to executive leadership on service trends, operational performance, and Escalated Service metrics.
* Maintain an effective on-call escalation rotation and coordinate with service management to ensure adequate technical coverage.
* Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve service delivery processes, procedures, and operational standards.
* Ensure processes are consistently followed, documented, audited, and updated as the organization grows.

* Identify tickets and activities that consume excessive technician time, taking corrective action while maintaining service quality and client satisfaction.
* Collaborate with project delivery, client account management, and sales teams to coordinate service activities and strengthen customer relationships.
* Lead employee development and performance management through weekly Level 10 meetings, quarterly conversations, and annual performance reviews.
* Promote a supportive and accountable team culture, contributing to a target voluntary employee turnover rate below 5% annually.
* Identify opportunities to introduce AI-powered tools and modern technology that reduce repetitive tasks and improve technician productivity.

**Requirements**
The ideal candidate is an experienced IT service delivery leader with a strong technical foundation and a deep understanding of the operational demands of an MSP environment. They should be comfortable managing multiple client accounts, developing technical teams, and balancing service quality with business performance.
  
  

* At least 5 years of experience in IT roles, including hands-on technical work in an MSP or service desk environment.
* At least 3 years of experience in a leadership or supervisory position.
* Strong understanding of MSP service delivery operations, including ticket queues, technician capacity, escalations, SLAs, documentation, client satisfaction, and operational KPIs.
* Hands-on experience with Autotask or a comparable Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform.

* Team-oriented leadership style, with a willingness to give and receive constructive feedback and prioritize collective success.
* Self-motivated, curious, and committed to continuous learning and professional development.

* Industry certifications strongly preferred, including Microsoft, CompTIA, or equivalent credentials. Additional certification requirements may be agreed upon during the hiring process.

Title: Network Operations Manager
Description:

**Position Summary**
The Network Operations Manager provides leadership in network operations, configuration management, and troubleshooting to ensure the delivery of high-quality services across all network-related functions. This role oversees the network operations team and is responsible for the performance, reliability, and support of the campus LAN/WAN environment. + Provide leadership, supervision, mentoring, and professional development for Network Operations and helpdesk staff.
+ Establish performance expectations, conduct evaluations, and support career growth for team members.
+ Recruit, hire, train, and retain highly qualified technical staff.
+ Foster a collaborative, customer-focused service culture across Information Technology.
+ Develop departmental goals, operational plans, and performance metrics aligned with University strategic objectives.

+ Lead the design, implementation, monitoring, and support of the University's enterprise network infrastructure.
+ Ensure reliable operation of wired, wireless, internet, VPN, cloud connectivity, telecommunications, and network security services.
+ Oversee lifecycle management of network hardware, software, and supporting technologies.
+ Maintain network architecture documentation, diagrams, standards, and operational procedures.
+ Manage network performance, capacity planning, and technology refresh initiatives.
+ Coordinate and support incident response activities related to outages, performance degradation, and infrastructure failures.

+ Assist with vulnerability management, security assessments, remediation activities, and compliance initiatives.
+ Participate in cybersecurity incident response and disaster recovery planning.
+ Identify operational and technology risks and develop mitigation strategies.

+ Oversee service desk escalation processes and support continuous improvement of IT service delivery.
+ Establish and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) and operational performance metrics.
+ Develop and maintain operational procedures, technical documentation, and knowledge resources.
+ Ensure business continuity, backup, and disaster recovery processes are maintained and tested.

+ Co-lead infrastructure modernization projects and strategic technology initiatives.
+ Develop project plans, timelines, resource estimates, and implementation strategies.
+ Participate in managing technology vendors, service providers, maintenance agreements, and licensing.
+ Participate in budget development, forecasting, and technology purchasing decisions.
+ Evaluate emerging technologies and make recommendations for adoption.

+ Partner with faculty, staff, and university leadership to understand business needs and deliver technology solutions.
+ Communicate operational status, project progress, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
+ Participate in institutional planning efforts and technology governance initiatives.
+ Promote effective collaboration across all IT functional areas.

+ Participate in after-hours maintenance windows and provide support during critical incidents when necessary.
+ Perform other duties as assigned including participation in annual commencement ceremonies.

**Required**
**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in network infrastructure, systems administration, or enterprise technology operations.
* Three (3) years of supervisory or team leadership experience. Ability to train, develop and encourage a staff of technicians.
* Experience supporting enterprise networking technologies, wireless infrastructure, routing, switching, firewalls, and network security. Experience with and good working knowledge of Domains, Segmentation, Account Management, Network backups, Trusts, Policies, Network Protocols, Bindings, Software Imaging, QoS.
* Experience with Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure/Entra ID, Exchange, Teams, Sharepoint, M365 CoPilot, Windows Server environments.

* Ability to work effectively and cooperate with staff, faculty, adjuncts, students and vendors.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience with cloud infrastructure and identity management platforms.
* Experience leading cybersecurity, disaster recovery, or infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Industry certifications such as Microsoft Azure Network Engineer (AZ-700), CISSP, CWNP, Network+, Security+, ITIL, or equivalent.

A large, nationwide organization is undertaking a major enterprise technology transformation through the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and the development of an internal SAP Center of Excellence (CoE). This is primarily a hands-on process leadership and service delivery management role rather than a traditional people-management position. The ideal candidate brings substantial experience managing major incidents within SAP environments, strong SAP S/4HANA technical understanding, and demonstrated success leading root-cause investigations, implementing permanent corrective actions, and holding external application support vendors accountable.

The position offers an opportunity to help build and mature incident and problem management processes within a growing SAP Center of Excellence, working closely with internal technology teams, business leadership, and external service providers.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead Major Incident Management activities for Priority 1 (Critical) and Priority 2 (High) SAP production incidents, coordinating rapid service restoration and minimizing business disruption.
* Direct emergency technical bridges and incident response efforts involving SAP Basis, IT infrastructure, networking, application development, external vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Establish and continuously improve incident intake, triage, severity classification, escalation, ownership, and resolution processes within the SAP Center of Excellence.
* Lead post-incident reviews and root-cause analysis to identify systemic problems, recurring incidents, and opportunities for permanent corrective action.

Title: Azure Cloud Delivery Manager
Industry: Accounting, IT Services and IT Consulting, and Business Consulting and Services
Description:
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
As a Delivery Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of an enterprise Azure managed services engagement for a US financial services client, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will own the day-to-day service relationship, drive SLA and compliance performance, and support estimation, planning and change orders to ensure successful outcomes.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
We are looking for a Delivery Manager to own the delivery of a three-year Azure managed services engagement. You will be the accountable point of contact for the client, leading the teams that Migrate, transition, operate and secure a mix of Azure workloads, including compute and operating systems, containers, serverless services, backup and disaster recovery, patching, vulnerability and security monitoring, and cost optimization
  
  
As a Delivery Manager, you will be the onshore Service Delivery Manager for a multi-year Azure managed services contract covering a mix of IaaS (several hundred virtual machines across production, non-production and disaster recovery) and PaaS/serverless services. You will lead Level 2 and Level 3 operations teams across onshore and offshore Delivery centres, run service governance with the client, and ensure the Migrate, Transition and Operate phases are delivered against contractual SLAs, security standards and cost commitments.
  
  
**Service Delivery & Contract Governance**

* Own end-to-end delivery across Plan & Define, Transition, and Operate (including the 90-day stabilization period), and maintain the Service Delivery Plan (SDP) as a living document.
* Deliver against contractual SLAs - incident response/resolution, VM availability, and DR RTO/RPO - reporting monthly and running governance forums (service reviews, optimization reviews, steering committee).
* Control scope and commercials: flag out-of-scope requests, raise change orders, and act as the escalation point for Priority 1 incidents.

**Azure IaaS & PaaS Operations Oversight**

* Oversee Level 2/3 support for Azure IaaS (VMs, networking, storage, firewalls/WAF, load balancing) and PaaS/serverless services, including the shared-responsibility boundary with Microsoft.
* Ensure golden, CIS-hardened images and IaC templates are maintained and used for all deployments, and oversee CI/CD, key/secrets management, and tagging standards.
* Coordinate with Microsoft support and the client on CSP-side incidents and platform maintenance.

**Incident, Problem & Change Management**

* Run ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management through ServiceNow - including the bidirectional eBonding integration - ensuring SLA-compliant prioritization (P1-P4) and root cause analysis for every P1.
* Govern change requests (standard/normal/emergency) including CAB approvals, and maintain clear hand-offs across client Level 0/1, Deloitte Level 2/3, and third parties.

**Security, Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure operational security controls are effective - IAM (SSO/MFA/PAM), credential rotation, and annual access reviews.
* Oversee vulnerability management (daily scanning, risk prioritization, monthly reporting), SIEM/log monitoring, and security incident response.
* Oversee cloud security posture management and compliance against NIST/CIS/CSA baselines, and support client audits and control requests.

**Backup, Disaster Recovery & Patching**

* Oversee backup/restore policies across block, object, file, and PaaS data; plan and oversee the annual DR fail-over/fail-back test, reporting measured RPO/RTO.
* Oversee the monthly OS patching cycle and CSP platform maintenance, communicating schedule and impacting the client.

**Transition, Automation & Observability**

* Lead transition into managed services - design workshops, solution documentation, tool deployment, and knowledge transfer to steady-state operations.
* Ensure monitoring/alerting/log management are configured to agreed thresholds, drive automation and continuous improvement (tracking MTTR and incident volume), and maintain client-facing reporting.

**FinOps & Financial Management**

* Define budget thresholds and track alerts; oversee the quarterly cloud optimization analysis and reservation/savings-plan reviews.
* Own delivery P&L inputs (utilization, productivity, revenue leakage) and partner with account leadership on renewals and extensions.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and coach technical leads and engineers across onshore and offshore Global Cloud Operations centers, including 24x7 on-call coverage for Priority 1 incidents.
* Manage capacity planning, staffing, and on-call models, and support career development, certification paths, and promotion readiness.

**The Team:**
At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.
  
  
This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.
  
  
The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in IT infrastructure services delivery, including 5+ years delivering Azure solutions.
* 3+ years as a delivery manager, service delivery manager or technical lead on an SLA-driven managed services engagement.
* Strong working knowledge of Azure IaaS: Windows and Linux VMs, VMSS, virtual networks, NSGs, Azure Firewall/WAF, load balancers, managed disks and storage, Entra ID and Key Vault.
* Working knowledge of Azure PaaS and serverless services (such as App Service, Functions and managed databases), including how operational responsibilities differ from IaaS.
* Understanding of backup and disaster recovery on Azure (Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery), RPO/RTO objectives and DR testing.
* Strong command of ITIL and ServiceNow, including incident, problem and change management, SLA reporting and ticketing integrations.
* Understanding of cloud security operations: vulnerability management, SIEM, endpoint protection, security posture management, IAM/PAM/MFA, and CIS and NIST controls.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD (Terraform or Bicep; Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and Windows/Linux patch management.
* Familiarity with monitoring and log management tools (such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or Datadog).
* Experience with cloud cost management, including budget alerts, optimization reviews and reservations.
* Commercial acumen across SOWs, SLAs, change orders and delivery financials.
* Strong stakeholder and executive communication skills, including client governance and escalation handling.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

**Preferred**

* Exposure to container platforms and Kubernetes operations (such as AKS).
* Cloud certifications (Azure preferred) and ITIL 4 certification are an advantage.
* Experience in banking or financial services is an advantage.

Title: Infrastructure Lead
Description:
**Role Summary:**

The Tech Lead – Windows Infrastructure, Cloud & Virtualization is a senior-level position responsible for leading the design, deployment, and management of complex Windows-based infrastructure, cloud solutions, and virtualization technologies, with a strong focus on O365 Administration. Managing Windows Server, Azure Cloud, VMware, backup solutions, and O365, ensuring seamless integration of on-premises and cloud environments. This position involves overseeing enterprise systems, optimizing performance, and ensuring scalability, security, and high availability. The Tech Lead will also mentor junior engineers, manage large-scale projects, and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver robust IT infrastructure solutions aligned with organizational goals. Strong troubleshooting, leadership, and strategic planning skills are essential for success in this role.

**Responsibilities:**

**Infrastructure Design & Management:**

- Lead the design, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise Windows infrastructure, including servers, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and related technologies.

- Architect and manage cloud infrastructure solutions on Azure, ensuring scalability, performance, and security.

- Oversee the design and management of virtualization environments using VMware, Nutanix and other platforms, optimizing for efficiency and uptime.

**O365 Administration & Management:**

- Manage the deployment, configuration, and administration of Office 365 services and applications, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and security management.

- Oversee user provisioning, license management, and collaboration tools integration within O365.

- Implement and maintain O365 security policies, including data loss prevention (DLP), compliance, and access controls.

**Cloud & Virtualization Integration:**

- Implement hybrid cloud solutions, integrating on-premises systems with Azure cloud platforms.

- Optimize and manage cloud resources for cost-efficiency and high availability.

- Drive the adoption of virtualization technologies to support the organization’s evolving infrastructure needs.

**Security & Compliance:**

- Ensure infrastructure security by implementing best practices for patching, backups, disaster recovery, and access control.

- Manage and configure enterprise backup solutions to protect critical data and ensure business continuity.

- Ensure systems are compliant with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.

**Leadership & Mentorship:**

- Lead and mentor a team of infrastructure engineers, ensuring the technical team stays up-to-date with industry best practices and certifications.

- Lead major infrastructure projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align infrastructure initiatives with business objectives and provide technical expertise to stakeholders.

**Troubleshooting & Optimization:**

- Lead the troubleshooting and resolution of complex infrastructure issues related to Windows Server, O365, cloud, and virtualization technologies.

- Continuously optimize infrastructure to improve performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.

**Documentation & Reporting:**

- Maintain detailed documentation of infrastructure configurations, architectures, and standard operating procedures.

- Provide regular status reports to senior management on project progress, system health, and security updates.

The incumbent is responsible for setting clear objectives and performance targets in collaboration with team members, ensuring alignment with overall organizational goals. This role involves actively mentoring, guiding, and providing direction to the team to cultivate skill development, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement. The incumbent applies structured performance management practices to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues, and drive the team towards achieving periodic KPIs. Through strategic oversight and regular feedback, the incumbent fosters a results-oriented environment, empowering the team to meet and exceed established benchmarks while supporting both individual and collective growth.

**Functional / Technical Competencies:**

- Proficient in Windows Server management (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, etc.).

- Strong expertise in VMware, Nutanix and virtualization technologies.

- Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud services and architecture.

- Experience with O365 Administration, including Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint management.

- Proficiency in backup solutions and disaster recovery strategies - Veem, Exagrid, Netbackup, Veritas

- Strong understanding of security best practices, identity management, and network configurations.

**Experience:**

- 15–20 years of experience in IT infrastructure management, with deep expertise in Windows Server, O365 Administration, Azure Cloud, VMware, Nutanix and related technologies.

- Extensive experience leading large-scale infrastructure projects and managing cross-functional teams.

Title: Director of Service Delivery - Remote
Description:
FusionTek is a growing managed services provider (MSP), and our Service Team is where our reputation is made. As
**Director of Service Delivery**
, you’ll lead the people who deliver it every day — the Reactive Service Team, the Escalated Service Team, and our Service Coordination Team.
  
  
You’ll report directly to the COO, own the service delivery engine of the company, and play a major role in whether we hit our aggressive growth goals. This role is built to evolve and grow as we do, if you want a seat where your impact is visible, this is it.
  
  
**Why MSP Experience Matters**
Prior MSP Help Desk leadership experience is strongly preferred. Leading service delivery in an MSP is significantly different from managing an internal IT department. An MSP supports multiple clients at the same time, each with different environments, priorities, SLAs, and expectations.
  
  
The Director of Service must be able to manage technician capacity, ticket queues, escalations, service levels, documentation, client satisfaction, and operational KPIs across multiple accounts simultaneously. We are looking for someone who already understands the pace and complexity of an MSP Help Desk and can step into the role ready to lead, improve, and scale the service organization.
  
  
**Why FusionTek?**
We’re Not a Startup Guessing Our Way Through, We’ve Spent 20 Years Building Something That Works, And We’re Just Getting Started. The Industry Has Noticed
  
  

* Inc. 5000 — Fastest Growing Private Companies in America
* MSP 501 — ranked among the top managed service providers worldwide
* Inc. Regionals Award — Pacific Northwest
* CRN MSP 500 — Pioneer 250 list

But the awards aren’t why people stay. They stay for the culture: team luncheons and employee events that actually feel like events, leadership that knows your name, and a company that shows up for the community — sponsoring and participating in local causes that matter to our team members. We work hard, we win together, and we make sure the wins are felt.
  
  
We’re also serious about staying ahead of the curve. We’re investing heavily in
**AI modernization**
— putting modern AI-powered tooling in our teams’ hands so technicians spend less time on repetitive work and more time solving real problems. When our people say they have the tools to get the job done, we take it seriously: if a tool makes the team faster and the client experience better, we build it, buy it, or adopt it.
  
  
And because we’re growing fast, this Director role isn’t a ceiling; it’s a launch pad. You’ll report directly to the COO and help shape how service delivery scales across the company.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the Service Team — direct day-to-day management of the Reactive, Escalated, and Service Coordination teams, including staffing, ticket life-cycle, and workload balancing by role and skill level.
* Own escalations end to end — make sure tickets escalate into and within Escalated Service (and to other FusionTek teams) correctly, using our SLA matrix to keep every ticket prioritized right.
* Drive the metrics that matter — manage the department to target KPIs for resolution time, CSAT, time spent, and more, and report weekly on service trends and Escalated Service metrics to the CEO.
* Keep the on-call rotation healthy — maintain the On-Call Escalated rotation and coordinate with the Service Desk Manager so coverage is always sufficient.
* Build and improve the playbook — create, update, and enforce the processes our Service Team runs on, keeping everything documented, audited, and regularly improved.
* Drive efficiency and protect margins — keep tickets moving and technicians focused, so time is spent where it creates value: ensuring a minimum of 6.5 billable hours logged per 8-hour shift, catching tickets that quietly over-consume time, and preserving both profitability and the client experience.
* Be the connector — partner with projects team, client account management, and sales so the Service Team and the whole company run smoothly and build client relationships that strengthen FusionTek’s reputation for technical excellence.
* Grow your people — conduct and share Service Team performance reviews through Weekly L10s, Quarterly Conversations, and annual reviews using our defined processes. Our goal: voluntary turnover under 5% annually.

**Requirements**
**Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years in IT roles, including hands-on technical work in an MSP or service desk environment, with 3+ years in a leadership or supervisory role
* Hands-on experience with Autotask or a similar PSA (we use Autotask and MSPbots to monitor ticket loads and progress)
* A solid technical foundation in a stack like ours — Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, Windows Server, networking fundamentals, and Datto BCDR. Direct experience with these exact technologies isn’t required, but comparable hands-on knowledge is: you can hold your own in a technical conversation, understand root causes well enough to challenge a resolution plan, and know when an escalation is heading the wrong direction
* Exceptional written and verbal communication — you can talk to technicians, clients, and the CEO with equal clarity
* A calm head under pressure: you manage multiple priorities, resolve conflict fairly, and solve problems before they become fires
* A team-first mindset — you give and accept feedback sincerely and put the team’s success above your own
* Self-motivated and curious; you enjoy learning new things
* A valid driver’s license and reliable, insured vehicle
* Industry certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Microsoft, CompTIA, or similar); additional certification requirements to be agreed upon during the hiring process
* High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred

**Benefits**
At
**FusionTek**
, we truly believe our people are our most valuable asset. That’s why we’re proud to offer:
  
  

* Competitive salary: $120k - $150k/year
* Bonus structure tied to personal and departmental KPIs — up to 4% per quarter plus an additional 5% annually
* Comprehensive coverage: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan with 4% company matching and immediate vesting
* Time Off That Actually Lets You Recharge: Generous PTO, Paid company holidays, Dedicated Birthday PTO and 2 additional floating holidays for extra flexibility
* Monthly cell phone stipend to support your connectivity needs
* Team culture: Fun events and opportunities to connect with colleagues

As an Incident Manager, you will drive rapid incident resolution, minimize business disruption, and uphold service excellence. You will lead high-impact response efforts, coordinate across teams, and drive root cause analysis to strengthen system resilience and operational efficiency.
  
  
This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and wants to make a tangible impact on business continuity within HS1. If you are passionate about ensuring seamless IT operations and driving continuous improvement, this is the role for you.

*This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. To be considered, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for Henry Schein One without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.*
**What You Will Do**

* Lead Incidents: Take command of incident bridge calls and chats, orchestrating response efforts across support, development, infrastructure, and business teams, and escalating to senior leadership when necessary
* Proactively Manage Risk: Coordinate teams to address hazardous conditions, such as loss of redundancy or potential widespread outages, before they become customer-impacting incidents
* Primary Escalation Point: Act as the central liaison during incidents, ensuring seamless communication between IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders
* Stakeholder Communication: Provide timely, clear updates in business language and manage expectations for leadership, support, and other key stakeholders during critical incidents
* Maintain Clear Documentation: Capture real-time timelines, decisions, and actions, and produce accurate impact statements, situation reports, and post-incident summaries that provide valuable insight for future improvements
* Drive Post-Incident Analysis: Lead reviews that uncover root causes, ensure ownership and timely documentation of root cause, track follow-up actions to completion, and reduce recurring issues

* Support Incident Management Improvements: Contribute recommendations for workflow, template, and tooling improvements that help reduce downtime, support service availability, and enhance response efficiency
* Collaborate Across Departments: Work closely with support, helpdesk, and development teams to analyze recurring incidents and proactively improve system stability
* Mentor & Guide Teams: Train and empower support and engineering teams in best practices for effective incident response
* Leverage AI to Work Smarter: Use AI tools throughout the incident lifecycle, from documentation and communications to timeline analysis and trend reporting, while validating accuracy, protecting confidential data, and remaining accountable for final decisions and outcomes

* 5 or more years of increasing responsibility in IT Incident Management
* ITIL Expertise: Working knowledge of the ITIL framework and IT service management best practices
* Incident Tracking, ITSM & Observability Tools: Hands-on experience with platforms like Jira Service Management, Dynatrace, Splunk, New Relic, or similar tools
* Collaboration & Communication Tools: Comfort running incidents through tools like Microsoft Teams and Confluence
* Cloud & Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with enterprise IT environments, cloud services, and infrastructure management, with some hands-on experience
* Change Management: Knowledge of best practices for managing IT changes efficiently
* Exceptional communication, multi-tasking, and conflict resolution skills
* Ability to build strong partnerships across all levels and departments within HS1
* Ability to analyze and solve complex problems and make quick decisions under pressure

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
* Exposure to Windows/Linux environments, SQL, Active Directory, and scripting
* Experience building or maintaining AI assets such as prompts, templates, or workflows that standardize operational documentation
* Certifications: ITIL Foundation, PMP, or relevant technical certifications

Title: Technology Lead, Government & Telecom
Description:
**The Role**
You’ll lead Echelon’s technical presales and solution strategy for AI, cloud and digital transformation opportunities across Government and Telco clients in KSA. As the senior trusted technical advisor to C-level stakeholders, you’ll shape winning solutions and turn business challenges into scalable, compliant technology programmes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**AI Strategy & Executive Ideation**

* Lead ideation and strategy workshops with C-level and senior government executives to define their AI vision and ambition.
* Co-create AI transformation strategies: identify and prioritise high-value use cases, assess AI readiness, and define target operating models.
* Translate strategy into phased roadmaps with business cases, governance, data foundations and quick wins.
* Shape new opportunities from strategy engagements, converting executive vision into fundable programmes.

**Presales & Solutioning**

* Own technical presales end to end: discovery, solution design, demos/PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals and pricing inputs.
* Design AI, data, cloud and infrastructure solutions aligned to client business outcomes.
* Lead complex cloud and infrastructure assessments, AI maturity assessments and transformation roadmaps.
* Build business cases and financial models (TCO/ROI) to support investment decisions.

**Consultative Selling & Client Leadership**

* Engage C-level and senior government stakeholders as a trusted advisor and position Echelon’s value consultatively.
* Partner with Sales and Account leads on account planning, opportunity qualification and deal strategy.
* Lead orals, technical presentations and executive workshops through to contract award.

**Technical Leadership**

* Set solution architecture standards and ensure the quality, feasibility and compliance of every proposal.
* Ensure a smooth handover from presales to delivery, and support delivery on critical engagements.
* Build, lead and mentor a team of solution architects and presales consultants.

**Ecosystem & Market**

* Manage technical relationships with hyperscalers and technology partners (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, G42, sovereign cloud providers).
* Track AI and cloud trends and Saudi regulatory direction, and translate them into offerings and go-to-market assets.

**Where We Align:**
**Experience**

* 12+ years in IT/technology, including 5+ years leading presales or solution architecture for large enterprise deals.
* A proven track record of winning and shaping engagements with government and public sector entities, ideally in KSA or the GCC.
* Hands-on experience with telecom operators (e.g. digital transformation, cloud, data or AI programmes).
* A track record of designing and selling AI, data and digital transformation programmes end to end.
* A background in a top-tier consultancy, system integrator or hyperscaler is a strong advantage.

**Technical Knowledge**

* AI/ML and GenAI solution architecture, including GPU/AI infrastructure and AI operating models.
* Multi-cloud and sovereign cloud strategy, architecture, migration and FinOps across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and local providers.
* Enterprise architecture, data platforms, infrastructure, virtualisation and security fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of Saudi frameworks, e.g. NCA cybersecurity controls (ECC/CCC), PDPL/SDAIA data requirements, DGA digital government standards and CST cloud regulations.

**Commercial & Consultative Skills**

* Strong consultative selling: discovery, value articulation, objection handling and executive negotiation.
* Proven ability to facilitate executive ideation sessions and build AI transformation strategies and roadmaps with senior leadership.
* Ability to build compelling business cases and turn technical value into commercial outcomes.
* Excellent executive presence; confident presenting to ministers, deputy ministers and the C-suite.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Saudi national.
* Fluent Arabic and English, written and spoken.
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Professional cloud/architecture certifications (e.g. Azure, AWS or GCP architect); TOGAF is a plus.
* An existing network across Saudi government entities and telecom operators.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Executive AI strategy engagements led and converted into opportunities.
* Presales win rate and total contract value influenced.
* Pipeline generated in the Government and Telco sectors.
* Quality and on-time submission of proposals and RFP responses.
* Client satisfaction and repeat business from key accounts.
* Team capability growth (certifications, retention, bench strength).

****THE SEAT****

* Location: Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
* Reports to: Head of Government & Telco
* Employment type: Full-time
* Target sectors: Government & Public Sector; Telecommunications

****OUR VALUES****

* Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* Builds others: You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

****HOW WE WORK****
You start from the problem, not the tool. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.
  
  

* Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves.
* Speed: You move from brief to a first working result quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* Rigour: You test claims against the data, check what is delivered and can explain every choice.
* Confidence & humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar organisation: you find a way with what is available.
* Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* A force multiplier: Your playbooks, reviews and coaching make the whole bench faster.
* AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you research, write and decide, and you have led the delivery of something real built on an LLM.
* Where you are: A senior presales and solution leader who has shaped and won large Government and Telco programmes, can hold the room with ministers and C-suite, and can still read an architecture and challenge an estimate.
