Title: Director of Service Delivery - Tampa
Description:
FusionTek is a growing managed services provider (MSP), and our Service Team is where our reputation is made. As
**Director of Service Delivery**
, you'll lead the people who deliver it every day — the Reactive Service Team, the Escalated Service Team, and our Service Coordination Team.
  
  
You'll report directly to the COO, own the service delivery engine of the company, and play a major role in whether we hit our aggressive growth goals. This role is built to evolve and grow as we do, if you want a seat where your impact is visible, this is it. This role will
**require a Hybrid schedule**
with at least two in-office days per week, based in our
**Tampa, FL**
office.
  
  
**Why MSP Experience Matters**
Prior MSP Help Desk leadership experience is strongly preferred. Leading service delivery in an MSP is significantly different from managing an internal IT department. An MSP supports multiple clients at the same time, each with different environments, priorities, SLAs, and expectations.
  
  
The Director of Service must be able to manage technician capacity, ticket queues, escalations, service levels, documentation, client satisfaction, and operational KPIs across multiple accounts simultaneously. We are looking for someone who already understands the pace and complexity of an MSP Help Desk and can step into the role ready to lead, improve, and scale the service organization.
  
  
**Why FusionTek?**
We're not a startup guessing our way through, we've spent
**20 years**
building something that works, and we're just getting started. The industry has noticed:
  
  

* Inc. 5000 — Fastest Growing Private Companies in America
* MSP 501 — ranked among the top managed service providers worldwide
* Inc. Regionals Award — Pacific Northwest
* CRN MSP 500 — Pioneer 250 list

But the awards aren't why people stay. They stay for the culture: team luncheons and employee events that actually feel like events, leadership that knows your name, and a company that shows up for the community — sponsoring and participating in local causes that matter to our team members. We work hard, we win together, and we make sure the wins are felt.
  
  
We're also serious about staying ahead of the curve. We're investing heavily in
**AI modernization**
— putting modern AI-powered tooling in our teams' hands so technicians spend less time on repetitive work and more time solving real problems. When our people say they have the tools to get the job done, we take it seriously: if a tool makes the team faster and the client experience better, we build it, buy it, or adopt it.
  
  
And because we're growing fast, this Director role isn't a ceiling; it's a launch pad. You'll report directly to the COO and help shape how service delivery scales across the company.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the Service Team — direct day-to-day management of the Reactive, Escalated, and Service Coordination teams, including staffing, ticket life-cycle, and workload balancing by role and skill level
* Own escalations end to end — make sure tickets escalate into and within Escalated Service (and to other FusionTek teams) correctly, using our SLA matrix to keep every ticket prioritized right
* Drive the metrics that matter — manage the department to target KPIs for resolution time, CSAT, time spent, and more, and report weekly on service trends and Escalated Service metrics to the CEO
* Keep the on-call rotation healthy — maintain the On-Call Escalated rotation and coordinate with the Service Desk Manager so coverage is always sufficient
* Build and improve the playbook — create, update, and enforce the processes our Service Team runs on, keeping everything documented, audited, and regularly improved
* Drive efficiency and protect margins — keep tickets moving and technicians focused, so time is spent where it creates value: ensuring a minimum of 6.5 billable hours logged per 8-hour shift, catching tickets that quietly over-consume time, and preserving both profitability and the client experience
* Be the connector — partner with projects team, client account management, and sales so the Service Team and the whole company run smoothly and build client relationships that strengthen FusionTek's reputation for technical excellence
* Grow your people — conduct and share Service Team performance reviews through Weekly L10s, Quarterly Conversations, and annual reviews using our defined processes. Our goal: voluntary turnover under 5% annually

**Requirements**
**Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years in IT roles, including hands-on technical work in an MSP or service desk environment, with 3+ years in a leadership or supervisory role
* Hands-on experience with Autotask or a similar PSA (we use Autotask and MSPbots to monitor ticket loads and progress)
* A solid technical foundation in a stack like ours — Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, Windows Server, networking fundamentals, and Datto BCDR. Direct experience with these exact technologies isn't required, but comparable hands-on knowledge is: you can hold your own in a technical conversation, understand root causes well enough to challenge a resolution plan, and know when an escalation is heading the wrong direction
* Exceptional written and verbal communication — you can talk to technicians, clients, and the CEO with equal clarity
* A calm head under pressure: you manage multiple priorities, resolve conflict fairly, and solve problems before they become fires
* A team-first mindset — you give and accept feedback sincerely and put the team's success above your own
* Self-motivated and curious; you enjoy learning new things
* A valid driver's license and reliable, insured vehicle
* Industry certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Microsoft, CompTIA, or similar); additional certification requirements to be agreed upon during the hiring process
* High school diploma required; bachelor's degree in a related field preferred

**Benefits**
At
**FusionTek**
, we truly believe our people are our most valuable asset. That's why we're proud to offer:
  
  

* 💰 Competitive salary: $120k - $150k/year
* 🎯 Bonus structure tied to personal and departmental KPIs — up to 4% per quarter plus an additional 5% annually
* 🌎 Must reside in Tampa area
* 🏥 Comprehensive coverage: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* 📈 401(k) plan with 4% company matching and immediate vesting
* 🌴 Time Off That Actually Lets You Recharge: Generous PTO, Paid company holidays, Dedicated Birthday PTO and 2 additional floating holidays for extra flexibility
* 📱 Monthly cell phone stipend to support your connectivity needs
* 🤝 Team culture: Fun events and opportunities to connect with colleagues

Title: Manager Data Center Operations
Description:
**Manager Data Center Operations**

**Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operationsis responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:

* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment
* Installation and management of all cable and network infrastructure supporting facility and customer connectivity
* Technical event management including post-event root cause analysis and infrastructure repair

**What you’ll do**

* Execute all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
* Supervises all construction activity and installations, in coordination with internal and external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.
* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design & Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move-ins and turn-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.
* Supervise local engineering team to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee execution of Digital Realty’s periodic maintenance program and maintenance calendar.
* Develop, implement and audit local standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to be in compliance with Digital Realty’s standards and industry best practices.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors and customers.
* Manage all maintenance and repair contracts to ensure compliance with maintenance standards and operational requirements. Confirm all vendors are qualified and adhere to Digital Realty’s performance standards and scopes of work.
* Responsible for timely execution of data center services such as remote hands, customer installations and service requests.
* Supervise security personnel and manage security systems including the adherence to security policies and compliance programs (as required by the Property Manager)
* Act as primary technical and operational contact for data center customers – both as the technical lead and local point of escalation during emergency events and day to day operations. Develop knowledge of customer’s core business and the business function of the customer’s local datacenter operation.
* Manage technical and operational incidents at the property, including the implementation of emergency response procedures, resource coordination, customer communication, root-cause analysis and post event remediation.
* Identify trends and analyze risks to articulate implications and impact to data center operations. Track operational metrics and other data to provide Senior Management oversight and control for both snapshot data and long-term trend analysis.
* Identify process based improvements that generate operational and financial efficiencies including the development and presentation of the business case.
* Support Property Manager with the management of expenses and assist all budgeting, forecasting and reporting requirements by providing capital and expense requirements and justifications.
* Support pre-sales process, including, but not limited to, conducting sales tours and reviewing lease proposals and lease agreements to confirm compliance with Digital Realty standards and local requirements.
* Support various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, SSAE16, SOC2, ISO 27001, etc. as may be required by Digital Realty.
* Maintain compliance with local health & safety (i.e. OSHA) standards and national electrical and building codes.

**What you’ll need**

* 10 years related facility management experience in data center operations (or related electrical or mechanical engineering field) with minimum of 5 years’ experience managing or leading data center operations teams in a large scale mission critical environment. Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering preferred.
* Solid and proven experience in the construction, commissioning, acceptance and operation of mission critical systems, including state-of-the-art electrical distribution systems, static and rotary UPS, emergency standby generation, fire alarm/suppression and monitoring systems
* Extensive knowledge of structured cabling systems, networking and connectivity standards, and hardware installation requirements.
* Proficient experience in colocation operations, including the installation and deployment of cage, rack and cable infrastructure, as well as, power circuit installation and power monitoring.
* Experience working with and deploying telecom and network providers, specifically in Meet Me Room and POP room environments
* Experience managing a change control environment
* Strong quantitative and qualitative reasoning skills, with demonstrated ability to determine event root causes, performance shortfalls and required corrective actions.
* Knowledge of industry data center standards, policies & methodologies
* Knowledge of performance management & critical awareness methods and implementation standards
* Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and detail oriented
* Experience managing own budget and analyzing expenses
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook and familiarity with Microsoft Project, Visio or AutoCad
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), and power metering system

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM), 5G/6G Wireless
Location: San Diego, CA, USA | Santa Rosa, CA, USA
Description:
**Overview**
Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
Run the program execution of Keysight's 6G collaborations with the leading wireless chipset and device makers, so that every commitment Keysight makes to these customers lands on the date the customer's engineers need it. The role exists so that Keysight's on-site engineers spend their time in the customer's lab.
  
  
The portfolio covers 6G research testbeds, pre-standard 6G test systems, protocol and physical-layer enablement, and demonstrations tied to the customer's development milestones, and it grows as the 6G programs ramp. The role is part of Keysight's customer-facing technical team for these accounts, within the Wireless organization. The engineering owners in R&D, firmware, planning, services, and support own the work; the program manager owns the plan, record, meetings, follow through, and the written recovery plan when a date does not hold. This is a role for someone who is relentless about documentation and tracking, who runs on data (every status is a number or a date with a source), and who sees around corners: anticipates what could go wrong and flags it early to the right leads.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* WHAT YOU WILL OWN

+ The program record for every engagement, kept current daily: status, named owner, next customer milestone, and date, with a plain reason and a recovery plan on every item that is not on track.
+ The plan of record for each engagement, managed to the customer's ready-to-use date, with Keysight's internal dates for shipment, installation, configuration, acceptance, and first measurements beneath it
+ The program meetings, internal and customer-facing: the agenda, each action assigned to a person with a due date, and the follow-up to closure between meetings
+ Commitments and risks across R&D, firmware, planning, services, and support: anticipated before they surface, tracked to their dates, renegotiated in writing before a date passes, and escalated to Wireless leadership the same day a commitment is known to be at risk
+ Readiness sign-off: no date or readiness claim reaches the customer until the program manager has reviewed the evidence behind it

**What You Will Deliver**

* A program plan per engagement, agreed with the customer's program counterparts and Keysight's R&D and planning owners within 90 days of start, refreshed at every milestone
* Meeting notes within one business day: decisions, owners, and dates
* A weekly written status: the situation, the implication, and the ask
* A monthly program readout: schedule performance against the plan of record, critical path, risks with owners, and a recommended course of action wherever the program is off plan
* A monthly quality report per customer: open issues by priority and age, turnaround against commitments, the trend, and the actions behind any line moving the wrong way
* A root cause and recovery plan on every missed customer milestone, written for an engineering executive audience

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customer milestones are met on the customer's dates
* Risks and slips are raised by the program manager, in writing, with the ask, before the customer or Keysight leadership raises them
* Every open engagement carries a current status, a named owner, a next milestone, and a date, at any point in time
* Plans, notes, status, and readouts are accepted by Wireless leadership at first review

On-site engineers' time is customer and lab time; the program meetings and records run without them in the room
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of technical, customer, or engineering program management in wireless, semiconductor, or test and measurement
* A record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs to completion through teams outside the program manager's own line, in a customer-facing environment
* Working knowledge of cellular systems: 4G and 5G today, the standards path to 6G, the modem and device development cycle, and how test equipment is deployed, accepted, and used in a customer's lab
* Fluency in program mechanics: plans of record, critical path, schedule trend against baseline, risk registers, recovery actions, and executive status reporting
* Relentless follow-through: asks the same owner for the same date until it is written down, and is comfortable being the person in the room who asks
* Rigor about evidence: checks what sits behind a date, a readiness claim, or a dependency rather than accepting it as reported
* Sees around corners: anticipates what could go wrong on a program before it does, and flags it to the right leads while there is still time to act
* Writing that stands on its own: notes, status, and readouts a senior engineering leader can act on at first reading
* Experience working directly with Director-level and above stakeholders, and the discretion to operate inside highly confidential development programs
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Ability to travel to customer sites as the programs require

Description du poste
  
  
Due to Government of Canada regulatory requirements, this position requires the successful completion of a Government of Canada Reliability Status screening as a condition of employment. The screening process requires 5 years of verifiable background history. This includes identity verification, education verification, a criminal record check, and a credit check. Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain Reliability Status, which generally requires Canadian citizenship or Canadian permanent resident status. Employment is contingent upon successful completion and maintenance of the required screening.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**
We are seeking a Manager, Network Reliability and Resiliency to lead a team responsible for the reliability and day-to-day operation of production network services supporting ServiceNow's cloud platform. This is a technical people-manager role. You will develop engineers and manage team priorities while staying actively engaged in complex troubleshooting, high-severity incidents, customer escalations, operational readiness, and reliability improvement.
  
  
You will apply SRE principles to network operations by using service indicators and objectives, error-budget thinking, observability, post-incident learning, and automation to improve availability, reduce operational toil, and make execution safer and more consistent. While this is not an individual contributor role, you must have the technical depth and judgment to guide investigations, challenge assumptions, make risk-based decisions, and help the team reach durable solutions.
  
  
**Lead and develop the team**

* Manage, coach, and develop network reliability engineers through clear goals, regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development.
* Set priorities and ownership for operational work, reliability initiatives, technical debt, and project commitments.
* Build sustainable on-call and escalation practices and promote calm, accountable execution during high-pressure events.
* Hire and onboard new team members and ensure they gain the technical context, operating practices, and support needed to succeed.

**Provide technical and incident leadership**

* Actively engage in complex production troubleshooting and customer-impacting escalations by reviewing evidence, guiding technical hypotheses, identifying risk, and coordinating the right subject-matter experts.
* Lead or support major incident response, including mitigation decisions, stakeholder communication, escalation management, and restoration of service.
* Ensure post-incident reviews identify contributing factors and result in clear, prioritized, and completed preventive actions.
* Review high-risk changes and operational plans for technical soundness, rollback readiness, monitoring coverage, and customer impact.

**Improve reliability through SRE practices**

* Partner with engineering and service owners to define and use meaningful SLIs and SLOs for network services.
* Use error budgets, incident trends, capacity signals, and operational data to balance service reliability, delivery pace, and risk.
* Improve observability, alert quality, dashboards, runbooks, and operational readiness so the team can detect and resolve issues efficiently.
* Track practical reliability outcomes such as availability, recurring incidents, change success, alert effectiveness, and time to detect and recover.

**Embed automation in daily operations**

* Create a strong automation mindset across the team and identify repetitive, error-prone, or slow operational activities that should be eliminated or automated.
* Prioritize automation that improves change safety, validation, triage, remediation, reporting, and operational consistency.
* Work with engineering and automation partners to move useful tools and workflows into production with clear ownership, documentation, monitoring, and support models.
* Measure whether automation reduces toil and operational risk rather than treating automation delivery alone as the outcome.

**Partner across the organization**

* Collaborate with network engineering, SRE, security, platform, data center, customer support, and other partner teams to resolve issues and improve service reliability.
* Represent the team's technical assessment, customer impact, risks, dependencies, and recovery plan clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Ensure new technologies, services, and automations meet operational acceptance criteria before the team assumes production ownership.
* Improve incident, change, problem-management, and escalation processes based on operational evidence and team feedback.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Five or more years of relevant experience in network engineering, network reliability, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or large-scale production operations.
* Experience managing or formally leading engineers, including prioritization, coaching, performance feedback, and delivery accountability.
* Sufficient hands-on technical background to guide production troubleshooting across Linux-based systems and network services. You can interpret logs, metrics, alerts, and packet-level evidence and make sound operational decisions.
* Working knowledge of networking concepts and technologies such as TCP/IP, routing, DNS, load balancing or ADCs, firewalls, cloud networking, and network observability. Deep expertise in every area is not required.
* Experience leading or coordinating significant incidents and customer-impacting escalations in an always-on service environment.
* Working knowledge of SRE practices, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring and alerting, incident management, and post-incident improvement.
* An automation mindset and experience using scripting, workflow automation, or engineering partnerships to reduce manual operational work and improve consistency.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and cross-functional partners in software, platform, infrastructure, or cloud services.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment under pressure, and consistent attention to detail.
* Experience using or evaluating AI-assisted tools to improve analysis, decision-making, automation, or team workflows, with appropriate attention to accuracy, security, and operational risk.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience operating networking for a global SaaS, large enterprise, cloud provider, or similarly complex production environment.
* Familiarity with BGP or OSPF, data center fabrics, load balancers or ADCs, DDoS protection, VPNs, firewalls, or public-cloud networking.
* Experience improving observability, change safety, capacity management, or operational readiness for production services.
* Experience with IT service management practices, including incident, change, and problem management.
* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Azure/AWS/GCP related

Title: Network Infrastructure Manager
Description:
**Summary**
The Network Infrastructure Manager leads Great HealthWorks' Network Operations and Telecommunications teams — System Administrators, Systems Engineers, Telecom Administrator, and Telecom Engineer/Architect — and carries direct technical accountability for the network, systems, and telecom environments the team supports. This includes firewalls and routing, server, storage, and virtualization infrastructure, as well as the Company's carrier, voice platform, and contact center stack.
  
  
This is a technical leadership position balanced with operational execution. The Infrastructure Manager serves as the primary owner of day-to-day operations and escalations, the main point of contact for business and IT stakeholders, and the driving force behind resolving complex technical issues. This role directly owns the operational layer while remaining hands-on enough to review designs, troubleshoot escalated issues, and lead through major incidents. Additionally, the role is responsible for instilling operational rigor—ensuring requirements discovery, runbooks, and post-change validation are seamlessly integrated into team workflows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Directly manage and mentor the Network Operations team (System Administrators, Systems Engineers) and Telecommunications team (Telecom Administrator, Telecom Engineer/Architect); set technical priorities and hold the team to a high bar on quality
* Stay close enough to the environment to review designs and configurations, unblock hard technical problems, and lead the team through major incidents, including voice platform and contact center architecture decisions
* Hire and retain strong technical talent, conduct performance reviews, and manage staffing and on-call coverage for a 24/7 environment

Operational Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary day-to-day operational and escalation owner for Network Operations and Telecommunications — the first point of accountability when something breaks or a decision is needed
* Own communication with business and IT stakeholders on service health, incidents, and project status, serving as a transparent, trusted advisor to leadership.
* Translate technical issues into business impact, risk, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders and leadership
* Drive issue ownership and follow-through, ensuring every open issue has a clear owner, mitigation plan, and target resolution timeline.
* Coordinate across IT, vendors, and business teams to keep cross-functional work and vendor commitments moving
* Maintain visibility into service health, aging issues, recurring problems, and operational risk, and surface it proactively rather than waiting to be asked
* Define and apply clear criteria for what gets escalated to IT leadership versus what this role is expected to own and resolve independently

Network, Systems & Security Operations
  
  

* Own network security (firewall), routing and switching, EDR, and DNS filtering
* Own enterprise storage (Nimble, QNAP, Quantum), XCP-NG virtualization, Windows and Linux server administration (Linux-heavy), Active Directory, and Okta
* Own Microsoft 365 administration and build out the team's SharePoint administration capability
* Own AWS, Cloudflare, and integration of the broader SaaS footprint, plus server backup and disaster recovery
* Maintain PCI compliance across in-scope systems, ensure SLAs are met, and drive capacity planning and script/automation practices across the team

Telecommunications Operations
  
  

* Own operation of the Company's custom-built phone system, voice and data carrier services, and the contact center platform (e.g., NICE InContact/CXone), including the design and engineering work done by the Telecom Engineer/Architect
* Manage carrier relationships, SLAs, and invoicing; monitor the telecom service ticket queue (InvGate) and drive escalations to resolution
* Ensure telecom integrations (contact center, voice platform, speech IVR, SMS) stay supported and issues are triaged quickly

Planning, Documentation & Vendor Management
  
  

* Scope infrastructure and telecom projects up front — gather real requirements, build workable schedules, and keep initiatives on track
* Require runbooks for recurring operational and change work, and a validation step after major changes, so outcomes are confirmed and documented rather than assumed
* Manage vendor and carrier relationships and contracts, build business cases for technology investments, and own the network/systems/telecom budget

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
* 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, network, systems, or telecommunications
* 3+ years leading or mentoring technical staff
* Experience scoping and running technical projects — gathering requirements and managing timelines — without a dedicated PM function
* Experience as the primary operational and escalation owner for a technical team, including regular communication with non-technical business stakeholders
* Strong understanding of ITIL and formal change management

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Deep, current technical knowledge of networking (OSI, TCP/IP, routing/switching), firewalls, and identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta)
* Hands-on experience with Windows and Linux administration, enterprise storage (Nimble/QNAP/Quantum), and virtualization (XCP-NG or equivalent)
* Experience with AWS, Cloudflare, Microsoft 365, and integrating a broad SaaS footprint; SharePoint administration a plus
* Experience with carrier/telecom management, contact center platforms, and PCI compliance
* Scripting and automation fluency (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ansible)
* Able to scope, document, and validate work without losing technical credibility with a highly technical team
* Strong ability to translate technical issues into business impact, risk, and next steps for non-technical audiences and leadership
* Proven stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills across IT, vendors, and business teams
* Excellent leadership and communication skills; highly self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working hands-on when needed

Physical Demands and Work Environment
  
  
While performing duties of job, incumbent is occasionally required to:
  
  

* May include local and out-of-town travel depending on business needs.
* Operate in a professional office environment.
* Constantly use work-related equipment.
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Sit for extended periods of time (up to 10 hours per day).
* Lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand, as necessary.
* Ability to work regular, full-time schedule, Monday through Friday with the flexibility to work additional hours depending on business demands.

At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**Salary : 72,521.00$-142,069.00$**

**Delivery Manager, CRM & Enterprise Applications**
to lead the operational delivery, stabilization, and continuous improvement of critical platforms supporting GreenShield’s contact centre and enterprise operations.

You will take ownership of delivery across an integrated technology environment that includes Microsoft Dynamics 365, NICE CXone, the Unified Service Layer, and Workday. You will bring together technical teams, vendors, product owners, and business stakeholders to resolve incidents, monitor service performance and costs, prioritize enhancements, and ensure our platforms continue to meet evolving business and customer needs.

During the initial stage, your focus will be on platform stabilization and operational readiness. As the environment matures, you will help shape the roadmap, identify improvement opportunities, and drive greater value from our technology investments.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Lead the day-to-day delivery and stabilization of CRM, contact centre, integration, and enterprise application services.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams during critical incidents, ensuring clear ownership, timely escalation, defined next steps, and effective communication.
* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, incident trends, backlog health, resolution times, and vendor performance.
* Lead root cause analysis and support the implementation of sustainable solutions that reduce recurring issues.
* Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to evaluate, prioritize, and deliver platform enhancements.
* Use operational data and customer interaction trends to identify opportunities for automation, improved call containment, better workflows, and enhanced user experiences.
* Monitor SaaS licensing, consumption, utilization, and platform costs against forecasts, identifying variances and emerging financial risks.
* Support the development of FinOps practices, cost reporting, and informed licensing decisions.
* Lead operational and technical governance discussions with vendors and internal partners.
* Maintain delivery playbooks, escalation paths, runbooks, service reporting, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure platform changes consider technical feasibility, security, cost, architecture, and operational impact.

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

You are an adaptable and accountable delivery leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, coordinate teams through complex operational challenges, and communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences. You are comfortable moving between incident management, service performance, vendor discussions, cost analysis, and continuous improvement.

Title: Site Security Manager - Michels Infrastructure Solutions, Inc.
Description:
**Project Security Manager**
============================

*Site Security | Access Control | Incident Response | Risk Management*

**Location:** Cheyenne, WY  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Arrangement:** Site Based

**Protect the People, Assets, and Operations Behind Mission-Critical Construction**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The successful delivery of hyperscale data centers and mission-critical infrastructure depends on maintaining a safe and secure environment for employees, contractors, visitors, equipment, materials, and project operations. As project sites grow in size and complexity, effective security leadership becomes a critical component of successful project execution.

As a **Project Security Manager**, you will serve as the General Contractor's primary security representative on one of North America's most significant mission-critical construction projects. You will coordinate with contract security providers, project leadership, owner representatives, subcontractors, emergency responders, and law enforcement agencies to support site security, access control, incident response, asset protection, and overall project security operations.

This role is ideal for an experienced security professional with a background in law enforcement, security management, military leadership, emergency response, critical infrastructure protection, or a related field.

**About Michels Infrastructure Solutions**
------------------------------------------

Michels Infrastructure Solutions (MIS) brings together the full capabilities of the Michels Family of Companies under a **Super General Contractor (Super GC)** model, providing mission-critical owners and developers with a single point of accountability for every phase of project execution.

By combining self-performed specialty design, construction, and commissioning services, MIS delivers large-scale, multidisciplinary projects with greater control over safety, quality, schedule, and cost.

MIS specializes in the delivery of hyperscale data centers and mission-critical facilities, leveraging expertise across mass grading and site development, wet and dry utilities, fiber and telecommunications infrastructure, ground improvement, deep foundations, structural concrete, power infrastructure, and commissioning. Our integrated delivery approach enables customers to partner with a single-source team capable of executing some of North America's most complex and demanding infrastructure projects.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As the **Project Security Manager**, you will serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related security matters while supporting the protection of personnel, assets, equipment, materials, and ongoing construction operations.

You will coordinate security activities between owner representatives, contracted security personnel, law enforcement agencies, emergency responders, subcontractors, and project leadership teams. This position plays a critical role in maintaining situational awareness, monitoring emerging threats, supporting incident response activities, and ensuring compliance with project security requirements.

Success requires sound judgment, strong communication skills, attention to detail, professionalism, and the ability to effectively manage security-related issues in a dynamic construction environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as the General Contractor's primary point of contact for all project-related security matters.
* Coordinate security activities between the owner, contract security providers, law enforcement agencies, emergency responders, subcontractors, and project stakeholders.
* Support implementation of site security plans, project security procedures, and customer requirements.
* Promote a proactive security culture across the project.
* Protect project personnel, facilities, equipment, materials, and critical infrastructure.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Coordinate daily security operations supporting a large mission-critical construction project.
* Support development, implementation, and maintenance of project security plans and procedures.
* Participate in project planning meetings and provide security guidance related to changing site conditions and construction activities.
* Coordinate site access control programs, badging requirements, visitor management procedures, and workforce accountability measures.
* Support investigations involving theft, vandalism, trespassing, workplace violence concerns, unauthorized access, and other security-related incidents.
* Ensure security incidents are appropriately documented, reported, investigated, and escalated.
* Coordinate responses to emergencies and security events that impact project personnel, assets, operations, schedules, or business continuity.
* Maintain situational awareness regarding changing site conditions, security concerns, and emerging risks.
* Support protection of project assets, materials, equipment, facilities, and critical infrastructure.
* Collaborate with Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) personnel to address overlapping safety and security concerns.
* Assist with security planning related to executive visits, customer visits, major deliveries, inspections, and other high-profile project activities.
* Monitor compliance with project security requirements, client requirements, contractual obligations, and company policies.
* Facilitate communication of security updates, incidents, emerging threats, lessons learned, and changing site conditions.
* Coordinate with subcontractors to ensure understanding of project security expectations and access requirements.
* Assist project leadership with security planning throughout project startup, active construction, and project closeout phases.
* Maintain compliance with all applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Title: Manager Network Infrastructure
Description:
**Company Information**
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Manager, Network Infrastructure is responsible for deploying, supporting, securing and managing the lifecycle of AEG Global Technology's network infrastructure across US venues and enterprise environments. This role ensures network services, firewalls, routing, switching, wireless platforms and related operational processes meet Global Technology standards, security requirements, governance controls and business priorities. The role also provides on-site event support across multiple venues and requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and participate in an on-call rota.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Line manage US-based network engineers (and contractors as required) and provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, prioritization and performance support in alignment with Global Technology objectives and ensuring service delivery meets established SLAs.
* Provide escalation support for critical network incidents, including out-of-hours response for venue, event and enterprise-impacting issues.
* Ensure existing network infrastructure is effectively managed, supported, patched, monitored and secured, including response to vulnerabilities, threats, audit findings and operational risks.
* Work with venue technology teams, business stakeholders, information security, operations teams and the Vice President, Network Infrastructure and Venue Technology to plan, budget and prioritize network infrastructure projects and service improvements.
* Project manage network infrastructure initiatives through the full lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, resource scheduling, implementation planning, change management, handover and documentation.
* Design and implement scalable, secure and supportable network infrastructure solutions that align with Global Technology architecture, security and operational standards.
* Maintain accurate design documentation, configuration records, operational runbooks, support models and standard operating procedures for all supported network services.
* Provide technical input and design review for venue technology, business systems, infrastructure, security, cloud and development initiatives where network architecture or connectivity is a dependency.
* Maintain current knowledge of network, wireless, firewall, automation, monitoring and security technologies and recommend improvements that improve resilience, performance, security and operational efficiency.
* Ensure network engineering practices, training, knowledge sharing and development plans support consistent delivery of Global Technology standards across venues and enterprise environments.
* Understand long-term business, venue and event technology objectives and recommend practical network strategies that support secure, resilient and scalable operations.
* Provide and promote a high standard of service ownership, stakeholder communication and continuous improvement across network operations and project delivery.
* Undertake other relevant duties or reasonable requests as required by the Vice President, Network Infrastructure and Venue Technology or senior Global Technology leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* BA/BS Degree (4-year) in Information Technology or related area.
* 4-6 years experience in a similar network infrastructure leadership role, including the design, implementation, support and lifecycle management of large-scale, multi-site and multi-tenant enterprise networks. Experience working with venue, event, corporate or highly available operational environments is preferred.
* Ability to manage, coach and develop network engineering staff, prioritize work across operational and project demands, and support performance, development and service ownership.
* Ability to build effective working relationships with venue technology teams, business stakeholders, vendors, information security, infrastructure, service desk and senior Global Technology leadership.
* Understand how technology enables and supports business objectives.
* Have significant experience configuring, managing and supporting Cisco and Meraki routing, switching, wireless, security appliance and cloud-managed network platforms.
* Have significant experience configuring and managing Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama and related security policy, segmentation, logging and operational governance processes.
* Have strong experience in network security, including segmentation, zero trust principles, access control, layer 2 security, layer 7 inspection, vulnerability response and secure change governance.
* Experience working across test, pre-production and production environments.
* Demonstrate strong expertise across core network technologies, including the OSI model; fibre, CWDM and DWDM transmission services; Ethernet and layer 2 switching, including VLANs, STP, MTU and layer 2 security; IPv4 and IPv6; VRF; GRE; routing protocols such as HSRP, VRRP, OSPF, EIGRP and BGP; route-based IPsec VPNs; multicast; QoS; MPLS and EoMPLS; network security and 802.1x; DNS; DHCP; and RADIUS.
* Troubleshoot complex network, voice and internet connectivity issues, including packet capture and analysis.
* Provide root cause analysis for major incidents and document findings for Global Technology and key stakeholders.
* Produce accurate, detailed reports while maintaining strong attention to detail and following agreed standards.
* Understand and consistently apply Global Technology standards for architecture, security, monitoring, documentation, vendor management, operational support and change control.
* Maintain high documentation standards, including architecture diagrams, configuration records, operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, change records, service incidents and post-incident reviews.
* Apply industry best practices to design and implement secure, practical technology systems and infrastructure.
* Use initiative, work with minimal supervision, manage time effectively and deliver within agreed timescales.
* Must be able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to support venues and live events.
* Willing and able to travel domestically.
* Demonstrate a positive, solutions-focused attitude.
* Collaborate effectively in a high-performing team environment.
* Maintain a strong commitment to high-quality delivery.
* Certification for core technologies is highly preferred.

* Establish and maintain migration plans, milestones, and success criteria for each customer.

Title: Head of Service Delivery
Description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.
  
  
We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Head of Service Delivery**
at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.
  
  
Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.
  
  
**What You Might Bring To The Table**
You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:
  
  

* Direct people-management experience leading managers or team leads, not just individual contributors.
* You are service-obsessed and focused on how we deliver outstanding service to patients, partners, and colleagues alike.
* A track record managing vendors within a healthcare operations role.
* Experience managing third-party vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and SLA governance.
* Experience overseeing Workforce Management (WFM) — forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
* Experience building or overseeing Quality Assurance (QA) programs, including audit frameworks and calibration.
* A data-first mindset, comfortable building and reading vendor and team scorecards.
* Comfort operating at high speed without compromising on execution quality.
* Strong communication skills, able to translate complex, cross-functional work for executives and your own team alike.
* Experience redesigning operational workflows around automation or AI, with results you can quantify: handle time, cost per order, headcount avoided.
* Able to build a capacity model that forecasts both human and automated throughput, and shows where the next headcount dollar should go versus the next automation dollar.
* Experience structuring vendor contracts for shifts in workload: volume flexibility, per-outcome pricing, exit terms, and automation clauses.
* Comfortable setting quality standards for automated and agentic systems, and holding Product and Engineering to them.
* A working view on PHI and AI: what data can enter which tools, what a BAA must cover, and how to audit it.
* Able to judge AI vendor claims. You can tell a demo from a deployed result and ask for the evidence.

**What You Will Achieve In This Role**
This role sits within Service Delivery, reporting directly to the SVP of Operations. You'll own two core pillars — Workforce Management (WFM) and Quality Assurance (QA) — plus our vendor partnerships, leading a small team of functional leads (a WFM Lead and a QA Lead) who run the day-to-day.
  
  
**Role**
As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:
  
  

* Build, lead, and develop a team of functional leads across WFM and QA, growing their capability to run their pillars independently.
* Own the end-to-end vendor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, contract structuring, performance management, and offboarding.
* Set the strategy for Quality Assurance (QA) — audit frameworks, calibration, scorecards, and coaching feedback loops. You will also be standing up the infrastructure for product testing on behalf of operational functions.
* Set the strategy for Workforce Management (WFM) — demand forecasting, staffing plans, scheduling, and capacity modeling — across internal and outsourced teams.
* Standardize reporting across QA and WFM, including SLA/KPI dashboards and vendor and team scorecards.
* Partner with the SVP of Operations on Service Delivery strategy, headcount planning, and budget for the function.
* Represent Service Delivery in cross-functional and executive conversations, translating team-level performance into business impact.
* Lead HIPAA compliance and data security oversight across all outsourced operations. - Own the automation roadmap for Service Delivery.
* Set and own a target for cost per order, defect rates, and key cost metrics
* Rebuild WFM to forecast mixed human and automated capacity, so staffing plans and vendor commitments track the real demand curve, in real time.
* Help set the quality framework for agentic workflows: error tolerance, escalation paths, human-in-the-loop points, and audit coverage.
* Act as the operational owner for Product and Engineering on Courier automation. Define what good looks like, test it, and sign off before patient-facing release.
* Make AI-assisted work the default across your team, and measure adoption and output gains at team level.
* Lead HIPAA and data security oversight across outsourced operations and AI tooling, including vendor due diligence and BAAs.

**Ai Requirements**
At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result.
  
  
**Tier 1 — AI-Native**
For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-native. You build with AI directly, shipping, automating, or prototyping real work with LLMs and agents, and have clear judgment on where humans must stay in the loop.
  
  

* You build with AI, not just alongside it. You've shipped, automated, or prototyped something real using LLMs, agents, or AI tooling.
* You can explain a workflow you redesigned so a machine does the boring 80%.
* You have a view on where agentic systems help and where a human must stay in the loop, especially in regulated, PHI-adjacent work.

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.
  
  
**How We Will Interview You**
We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:
  
  

* 30-minute introductory phone call with our Senior Talent Partner.
* If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.
* 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to this role (see AI Requirements above).
* Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.
* Offer!

**What We Offer**
We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:
  
  

* Salary range of $150,000 - $180,000
* Equity package
* Flexible remote or hybrid work options

* Medical, vision, and dental coverage
* 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best
* Paid parental leave
* 401k retirement plan
* All the equipment you need to do your best work
* Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team

**DIVERSITY AT**
**SCAN.COM**
Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.
  
  
We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.
  
  
Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.
  
  
If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application!

Title: Sr Manager, IT Service Delivery
Description:
Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.
  
  
Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.
  
  
*Build the service model. Lead the team. Shape how our employees experience IT.*
We are a young, growing company, and our IT organization is growing with it. That makes this a build-and-lead role, not a caretaker role. The person who joins us will have the opportunity to define and own how IT service delivery works across the organization: how employees get help, how support is staffed and measured, how issues are escalated, how vendors fit into the model, and what a great technology experience should look like as we scale.
  
  
The audience is broad. You and your team will support field personnel, commercial and sales teams as those capabilities grow, R&D engineers, Quality and regulatory functions, corporate teams, executives, and everyone in between. This role will be one of the most visible faces of IT to our internal customers. How this function performs will shape how the organization experiences and judges IT - good or bad.
  
  
We are looking for a leader who values real IT discipline and great customer experience, in equal measure. Great CX does not mean saying yes to everything. It means being responsive, reliable, consistent, easy to work with, transparent about priorities, and willing to say “no” or “not that way” when a one-off request conflicts with security, standards, scalability, or our shared business goals. It also means representing the internal customer inside IT and holding our own teams and partners accountable when the experience, responsiveness, or quality of service falls short of the standard we are trying to build.
  
  
As Anteris grows, this role will grow with it. The service model, team structure, global coverage, technology estate, and business expectations will all become more complex. For the right leader, that creates meaningful opportunity to expand scope, responsibility, and career progression as the company and IT organization mature.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Lead and develop our Service Desk, deskside support, and related Service Delivery resources (employees, contractors, and service partners) with clear expectations, coaching, accountability, and career development.
* Define and mature a scalable global IT service-delivery model across support channels, locations, vendors, escalation paths, service levels, and operating hours.
* Own the employee technology experience within Service Delivery and use service data, customer feedback, ticket trends, and direct engagement to identify friction and drive measurable improvement.
* Establish practical ITSM discipline across incident, request, problem, knowledge, change, service catalog, asset, and continual-improvement practices. We want rigor that improves outcomes, not process for process’s sake.
* Lead significant incidents and escalations with calm, clear ownership — coordinating technical teams, vendors, business stakeholders, communications, and follow-through through resolution and post-incident improvement.
* Lead Service Delivery projects and improvement initiatives such as ITSM enhancements, service-model changes, endpoint or technology deployments, office/site support changes, vendor transitions, automation, and self-service improvements.
* Own service-provider performance and ensure MSPs and vendors operate as an extension of our team, with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, customer experience, and contractual commitments.
* Lead end-user technology fulfillment and lifecycle practices, including onboarding/offboarding, device provisioning, asset control, refresh planning, recovery, and retirement.
* Partner closely with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Applications, Data, Quality, HR, Facilities, and business leadership so employees experience one IT organization rather than disconnected technical teams.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Employees know where to go for help, receive consistent service, and trust that IT will own issues through resolution.
* The Service Delivery team is well-led, accountable, developing professionally, and increasingly able to solve problems without unnecessary escalation.
* Service levels, backlog, recurring issues, customer experience, vendor performance, and improvement priorities are visible and actively managed, not anecdotally.
* IT becomes more disciplined as we grow: better standardization, better knowledge, more automation, fewer repeat problems, and clearer ownership.
* You are a credible partner to the business: customer-focused and pragmatic, while protecting enterprise standards, security, compliance, scalability, and shared priorities.
* You are a credible leader inside of IT - where we look to you for voice-of-the-customer and help IT deliver IT correctly.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, IT operations, end-user computing, IT service management, or related technology disciplines.
* 5+ years of people-management experience with direct leadership of Service Desk, deskside/end-user support, IT operations, or comparable technology teams.

* Strong, practical ITSM experience and an understanding of ITIL principles, service levels, problem management, knowledge management, change, metrics, and continual improvement.
* Experience leading technology or service-improvement projects from planning through implementation and transition to support; formal project-management certification is useful but not required.
* Experience using service-performance and customer-experience data to make decisions, identify systemic issues, and drive improvement.
* Experience managing MSPs, contractors, vendors, and blended internal/external delivery models with measurable performance expectations.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft-centric workplace technology, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, SaaS applications, endpoint management, identity/access concepts, and enterprise service-management tools.
* Experience supporting multiple sites or a distributed/global workforce.
* Experience in medical device, life sciences, manufacturing, healthcare, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
* A leadership style that combines service orientation, sound judgment, technical credibility, operational discipline, and the confidence to challenge weak assumptions or unsustainable requests.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to make a significant impact on the healthcare industry by advancing groundbreaking therapies.
* Inclusive Team Environment, collaborative and dynamic work environment with a culture of innovation and excellence.
* Competitive compensation package, including salary, performance-based bonuses, and stock options.

* Bonus Plan Eligibility

Title: Lead Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Business Introduction**
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Digital & Tech Command Centre operates 24x7x365 to protect GSK’s critical sites, applications and services. Disruption or degradation to these directly impacts patient supply, research and colleague productivity.
  
  
This role owns and leads the end-to-end response to Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents. In collaboration with AI-enabled monitoring, detection and triage capabilities, the role directs resolver
  
  
teams and subject matter experts from across Tech towards the fastest possible restoration of service, while providing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate communication to end users, senior stakeholders and
  
  
executive leadership. The role also assesses incidents for crisis potential, secures the quality of the incident record for downstream Problem Management, and drives continuous improvement in prevention, detection and response - including the adoption of AI and automation to shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore. As a more experienced member of the Major Incident Manager team, the role additionally acts as an escalation point within the team, to support less experienced colleagues, as well as to field senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information. Additionally, the role supports management of the shift rota, supports the personal
  
  
development of Major Incident Managers through structured feedback and mentoring and leads service-related objectives such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
**Major Incident Response & Command**

* Own the end-to-end management of Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents, from detection through to confirmed service restoration, acting as the single point of control for the duration of the incident.
* Rapidly establish impact, urgency and scope, confirm correct prioritisation, and drive immediate engagement of the right resolver teams, subject matter experts and vendors.
* Lead technical bridges with authority, keeping activity focused on restoration, controlling scope, and ensuring hypotheses are tested and eliminated systematically.
* Drive and record decisions under pressure – balancing speed of restoration against risk.
* Drive resolution against agreed major incident targets, escalating promptly where progress stalls or
* additional authority, resource or vendor commitment is required.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Own incident communications, producing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate updates, including for senior leaders, at agreed intervals.
* Translate complex technical detail into clear business impact language, setting realistic expectations on restoration.
* Act as an escalation point for senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information, coordinating accurate, consistent responses across resolver teams and owning follow-up through to closure.

**Incident Assessment, Categorisation & Escalation**

* Continuously assess live incidents for impact, applying criteria to determine appropriate handling.
* Trigger escalation routes without delay, providing the initial situational assessment.
